verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਢਕਣ ਕੂ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prem paTolaa tai seh dhitaa ddakan koo pat meree ||
verses.translation: O Husband Lord, You have given me the silk gown of Your Love to cover and protect my honor.

verses.original: ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਈ ਮੈਡਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaanaa beenaa saiee maiddaa naanak saar na jaanaa teree ||1||
verses.translation: You are all-wise and all-knowing, O my Master; Nanak: I have not appreciated Your value, Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੈਡੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਧਮੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: taiddai simaran habh kichh ladham bikham na ddiTham koiee ||
verses.translation: By Your meditative remembrance, I have found everything; nothing seems difficult to me.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis pat rakhai sachaa saahib naanak meT na sakai koiee ||2||
verses.translation: One whose honor the True Lord Master has preserved - O Nanak, no one can dishonor him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਦਯਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ॥
verses.translit: hovai sukh ghanaa dhay dhiaaiaai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, there comes a great peace.

verses.original: ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਐ ॥
verses.translit: va(n)n(j)ai rogaa ghaan har gun gaiaai ||
verses.translation: Multitudes of illnesses vanish, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਠਾਢਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar varatai Thaadd prabh chit aaiaai ||
verses.translation: Utter peace pervades within, when God comes to mind.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਐ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hovai aas nai ma(n)n vasaiaai ||
verses.translation: One's hopes are fulfilled, when one's mind is filled with the Name.

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਐ ॥
verses.translit: koi na lagai bighan aap gavaiaai ||
verses.translation: No obstacles stand in the way, when one eliminates his self-conceit.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਐ ॥
verses.translit: giaan padhaarath mat gur te paiaai ||
verses.translation: The intellect attains the blessing of spiritual wisdom from the Guru.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਐ ॥
verses.translit: tin paae sabhe thok jis aap dhivaiaai ||
verses.translation: He receives everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਐ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: too(n) sabhanaa kaa khasam sabh teree chhaiaai ||8||
verses.translation: You are the Lord and Master of all; all are under Your Protection. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਦੀ ਤਰੰਦੜੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਖੋਜੁ ਨ ਖੁੰਭੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: nadhee tara(n)dhaRee maiddaa khoj na khu(n)bhai ma(n)jh muhabat teree ||
verses.translation: Crossing the stream, my foot does not get stuck - I am filled with love for You.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਚਰਣੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਹੀਅੜਾ ਸੀਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਬੇੜੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau seh charanee maiddaa heeaRaa seetam har naanak tulahaa beRee ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, my heart is attached to Your Feet; the Lord is Nanak's raft and boat. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਦਿਸੰਦੜਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵੰਞੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਾਡੜੇ ਸੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa dhisa(n)dhaRiaa dhuramat va(n)n(j)ai mitr asaaddaRe seiee ||
verses.translation: The sight of them banishes my evil-mindedness; they are my only true friends.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau ddooddedhee jag sabaiaa jan naanak virale keiee ||2||
verses.translation: I have searched the whole world; O servant Nanak, how rare are such persons! ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavai saahib chit teriaa bhagataa ddiThiaa ||
verses.translation: You come to mind, O Lord and Master, when I behold Your devotees.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man kee kaTeeaai mail saadhasa(n)g vuThiaa ||
verses.translation: The filth of my mind is removed, when I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran bhau kaTeeaai jan kaa sabadh jap ||
verses.translation: The fear of birth and death is dispelled, meditating on the Word of His humble servant.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਖੋਲਨਿੑ ਸੰਤ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਛਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kholani(h) sa(n)t dhoot sabh jaeh chhap ||
verses.translation: The Saints untie the bonds, and all the demons are dispelled.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਨਿੑ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis siau laini(h) ra(n)g jis dhee sabh dhaareeaa ||
verses.translation: They inspire us to love Him, the One who established the entire universe.

verses.original: ਊਚੀ ਹੂੰ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: uoochee hoo(n) uoochaa thaan agam apaareeaa ||
verses.translation: The seat of the inaccessible and infinite Lord is the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas kar joR saas saas dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, with each and every breath, meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਭਗਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jaa aape hoi dhiaal taa(n) bhagat sa(n)g paieeaai ||9||
verses.translation: When the Lord Himself becomes merciful, then we attain the Society of His devotees. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਨੜੈ ਹੁੰਮਸ ਧੁੰਮਸ ਕੂਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: baar viddaanaRai hu(n)mas dhu(n)mas kookaa pieeaa raahee ||
verses.translation: In this wondrous forest of the world, there is chaos and confusion; shrieks emanate from the highways.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਗੜੀ ਡੋਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau seh setee lagaRee ddoree naanak anadh setee ban gaahee ||1||
verses.translation: I am in love with You, O my Husband Lord; O Nanak, I cross the jungle joyfully. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬੈਸਕ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baisak tin(h)aa sa(n)g jin sa(n)g japeeaai naau ||
verses.translation: The true society is the company of those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin(h) sa(n)g sa(n)g na keechiee naanak jinaa aapanaa suaau ||2||
verses.translation: Do not associate with those, O Nanak, who look out only for their own interests. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saa velaa paravaan jit satigur bheTiaa ||
verses.translation: Approved is that time, when one meets the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਤੇਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hoaa saadhoo sa(n)g fir dhookh na teTiaa ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he does not suffer pain again.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਲੇਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa nihachal thaan fir garabh na leTiaa ||
verses.translation: When he attains the eternal place, he does not have to enter the womb again.

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਇਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee aaiaa ik sagal brahameTiaa ||
verses.translation: He comes to see the One God everywhere.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੇਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tat giaan lai dhiaan dhirasaT sameTiaa ||
verses.translation: He focuses his meditation on the essence of spiritual wisdom, and withdraws his attention from other sights.

verses.original: ਸਭੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੋਲੇਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabho japeeaai jaap j mukhahu boleTiaa ||
verses.translation: All chants are chanted by one who chants them with his mouth.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੇਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hukame bujh nihaal sukh sukheTiaa ||
verses.translation: Realizing the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he becomes happy, and he is filled with peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਏ ਸੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਖੋਟਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: parakh khajaanai paae se bahuR na khoTiaa ||10||
verses.translation: Those who are assayed, and placed in the Lord's treasury, are not declared counterfeit again. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਛੋਹੇ ਜੰਬੂਰ ਖਵੇ ਨ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗਾਖੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: vichhohe ja(n)boor khave na va(n)n(j)n gaakhaRe ||
verses.translation: The pincers of separation are so painful to endure.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਮਿਲੰਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: je so dhanee mila(n)n naanak sukh sa(n)booh sach ||1||
verses.translation: If only the Master would come to meet me! O Nanak, I would then obtain all the true comforts. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਮੀ ਵਸੰਦੀ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਈਧਣੁ ਰਖੈ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jimee vasa(n)dhee paaneeaai ieedhan rakhai bhaeh ||
verses.translation: The earth is in the water, and the fire is contained in the wood.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਆਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਢਲਿ ਹਭੁ ਕੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so sahu aaeh jaa kai aaddal habh ko ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, yearn for that Lord, who is the Support of all. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੰਮ ਤੁਧੈ ਹੀ ਗੋਚਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tere keete ka(n)m tudhai hee gochare ||
verses.translation: The works which You have done, O Lord, could only have been performed by You.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: soiee varatai jag j keeaa tudh dhure ||
verses.translation: That alone happens in the world, which You, O Master, have done.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: bisam bhe bisamaadh dhekh kudharat tereeaa ||
verses.translation: I am wonderstruck beholding the wonder of Your Almighty Creative Power.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: saran pare teree dhaas kar gat hoi mereeaa ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary - I am Your slave; if it is Your Will, I shall be emancipated.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: terai hath nidhaan bhaavai tis dheh ||
verses.translation: The treasure is in Your Hands; according to Your Will, You bestow it.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis no hoi dhiaal har naam sei leh ||
verses.translation: One, upon whom You have bestowed Your Mercy, is blessed with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar bea(n)t a(n)t na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: You are unapproachable, unfathomable and infinite; Your limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jis no hoh kirapaalu su naam dhiaaieeaai ||11||
verses.translation: One, unto whom You have been compassionate, meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੜਛੀਆ ਫਿਰੰਨਿੑ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿੑ ਸੁਞੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaRachheeaa fira(n)ni(h) suaau na jaanani(h) sun(j)eeaa ||
verses.translation: The ladles cruise through the food, but they do not know the taste of it.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਮੁਖ ਦਿਸੰਨਿੑ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: seiee mukh dhisa(n)ni(h) naanak rate prem ras ||1||
verses.translation: I long to see the faces of those, O Nanak, who are imbued with the essence of the Lord's Love. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖੋਜੀ ਲਧਮੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਛਡੀਆ ਉਜਾੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: khojee ladham khoj chhaddeeaa ujaaR ||
verses.translation: Through the Tracker, I discovered the tracks of those who ruined my crops.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਖੇਤੁ ਨ ਛਿਜਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tai seh dhitee vaaR naanak khet na chhijiee ||2||
verses.translation: You, O Lord, have put up the fence; O Nanak, my fields shall not be plundered again. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਰਾਧਿਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaraadhih sachaa soi sabh kichh jis paas ||
verses.translation: Worship in adoration that True Lord; everything is under His Power.

verses.original: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhuhaa siriaa khasam aap khin meh kare raas ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Master of both ends; in an instant, He adjusts our affairs.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: tiaagahu sagal upaav tis kee oT gahu ||
verses.translation: Renounce all your efforts, and hold fast to His Support.

verses.original: ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਲਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: pau saranaiee bhaj sukhee hoo(n) sukh lahu ||
verses.translation: Run to His Sanctuary, and you shall obtain the comfort of all comforts.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam tat giaan sa(n)taa sa(n)g hoi ||
verses.translation: The karma of good deeds, the righteousness of Dharma and the essence of spiritual wisdom are obtained in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: japeeaai a(n)mirat naam bighan na lagai koi ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, no obstacle shall block your way.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis no aap dhiaal tis man vuThiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord abides in the mind of one who is blessed by His Kindness.

verses.original: ਪਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤੁਠਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: paieeani(h) sabh nidhaan saahib tuThiaa ||12||
verses.translation: All treasures are obtained, when the Lord and Master is pleased. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਧਮੁ ਲਭਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ladham labhanahaar karam kara(n)dho maa piree ||
verses.translation: I have found the object of my search - my Beloved took pity on me.

verses.original: ਇਕੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਪਸੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eiko sirajanahaar naanak biaa na paseeaai ||1||
verses.translation: There is One Creator; O Nanak, I do not see any other. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਪੜਿਆ ਪਛਾੜਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ਸੰਨਿੑ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: paapaRiaa pachhaaR baan sachaavaa sa(n)ni(h) kai ||
verses.translation: Take aim with the arrow of Truth, and shoot down sin.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੜਾ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਵਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur ma(n)traRaa chitaar naanak dhukh na theeviee ||2||
verses.translation: Cherish the Words of the Guru's Mantra, O Nanak, and you shall not suffer in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਠਾਢਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu sirajanahaar paieean Thaadd aap ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Creator Lord Himself has brought about peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t miharavaan tis no sadhaa jaap ||
verses.translation: He is Kind to all beings and creatures; meditate forever on Him.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਮਰਥਿ ਚੁਕੇ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhaaree samarath chuke bil bilaap ||
verses.translation: The all-powerful Lord has shown Mercy, and my cries of suffering are ended.

verses.original: ਨਠੇ ਤਾਪ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: naThe taap dhukh rog poore gur prataap ||
verses.translation: My fevers, pains and diseases are gone, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਰਖ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: keeteean aapanee rakh gareeb nivaaj thaap ||
verses.translation: The Lord has established me, and protected me; He is the Cherisher of the poor.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape lian chhaddai ba(n)dhan sagal kaap ||
verses.translation: He Himself has delivered me, breaking all my bonds.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਆਸ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: tisan bujhee aas pu(n)nee man sa(n)tokh dhraap ||
verses.translation: My thirst is quenched, my hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is contented and satisfied.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਹੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਖਸਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਾਪਿ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: vaddee hoo(n) vaddaa apaar khasam jis lep na pu(n)n paap ||13||
verses.translation: The greatest of the great, the Infinite Lord and Master - He is not affected by virtue and vice. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bhe kirapaal prabh har har seiee japaat ||
verses.translation: They alone meditate on the Lord God, Har, Har, unto whom the Lord is Merciful.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak preet lagee tin raam siau bheTat saadh sa(n)gaat ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they enshrine love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam ramahu baddabhaageeho jal thal maheeal soi ||
verses.translation: Contemplate the Lord, O very fortunate ones; He is pervading in the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਐ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam araadhiaai bighan na laagai koi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal encounters no misfortune. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kaa boliaa paravaan hai dharageh pavai thai ||
verses.translation: The speech of the devotees is approved; it is accepted in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa teree Tek rate sach nai ||
verses.translation: Your devotees take to Your Support; they are imbued with the True Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no hoi kirapaal tis kaa dhookh jai ||
verses.translation: One unto whom You are Merciful, has his sufferings depart.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਓਨੑਾ ਮਿਹਰ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat tere dhiaal on(h)aa mihar pai ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, You bless Your devotees with Your Grace.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh vadd rog na pohe tis mai ||
verses.translation: Suffering, pain, terrible disease and Maya do not afflict them.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa eh adhaar gun govi(n)dh gai ||
verses.translation: This is the Support of the devotees, that they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa dhin rain iko ik dhiaai ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, day and night, they meditate on the One and Only Lord.

verses.original: ਪੀਵਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: peevat a(n)mirat naam jan naame rahe aghai ||14||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Amrit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servants remain satisfied with the Naam. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT bighan tis laagate jis no visarai naau ||
verses.translation: Millions of obstacles stand in the way of one who forgets the Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak anadhin bilapate jiau su(n)n(j)ai ghar kaau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, night and day, he croaks like a raven in a deserted house. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਿਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: piree milaavaa jaa theeaai saiee suhaavee rut ||
verses.translation: Beauteous is that season, when I am united with my Beloved.

verses.original: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵੀਐ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaRee muhat neh veesarai naanak raveeaai nit ||2||
verses.translation: I do not forget Him for a moment or an instant; O Nanak, I contemplate Him constantly. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਵਰੀਆਮ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋੜੀਐ ॥ ਫਉਜ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਹਾਠ ਪੰਚਾ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: soorabeer vareeaam kinai na hoReeaai || fauj sataanee haaTh pa(n)chaa joReeaai ||
verses.translation: Even brave and mighty men cannot withstand the powerful and overwhelming army which the five passions have gathered.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਉਧੂਤ ਦੇਨਿ ਚਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhas naaree aaudhoot dhen chamoReeaai ||
verses.translation: The ten organs of sensation attach even detached renunciates to sensory pleasures.

verses.original: ਜਿਣਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਲੈਨਿੑ ਰਲਾਇ ਏਹੋ ਏਨਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jin jin laini(h) ralai eho enaa loReeaai ||
verses.translation: They seek to conquer and overpower them, and so increase their following.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun in kai vas kinai na moReeaai ||
verses.translation: The world of the three dispositions is under their influence; no one can stand against them.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਖਾਈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bharam koT maiaa khaiee kahu kit bidh toReeaai ||
verses.translation: So tell me - how can the fort of doubt and the moat of Maya be overcome?

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਦਲੁ ਫੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa aaraadh bikham dhal foReeaai ||
verses.translation: Worshipping the Perfect Guru, this awesome force is subdued.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: hau tis agai dhin raat rahaa kar joReeaai ||15||
verses.translation: I stand before Him, day and night, with my palms pressed together. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭੇ ਉਤਰਨਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kilavikh sabhe utaran neet neet gun gaau ||
verses.translation: All sins are washed away, by continually singing the Lord's Glories.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸਾ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT kalesaa uoopajeh naanak bisarai naau ||1||
verses.translation: Millions of afflictions are produced, O Nanak, when the Name is forgotten. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur bheTiaai pooree hovai jugat ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one comes to know the Perfect Way.

verses.original: ਹਸੰਦਿਆ ਖੇਲੰਦਿਆ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਖਾਵੰਦਿਆ ਵਿਚੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hasa(n)dhiaa khela(n)dhiaa paina(n)dhiaa khaava(n)dhiaa viche hovai mukat ||2||
verses.translation: While laughing, playing, dressing and eating, he is liberated. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮ ਗੜੁ ਤੋੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur dhan dha(n)n jin bharam gaR toRiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has demolished the fortress of doubt.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur vaahu vaahu jin har siau joRiaa ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail! Hail! to the True Guru, who has united me with the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਰੂਓ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan akhuT gur dhei dhaarooo ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given me the medicine of the inexhaustible treasure of the Naam.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਤਿਨੈ ਬਿਦਾਰੂਓ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa rog bikaraal tinai bidhaarooo ||
verses.translation: He has banished the great and terrible disease.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa naam nidhaan bahut khajaaniaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the great treasure of the wealth of the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jitaa janam apaar aap pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained eternal life, recognizing my own self.

verses.original: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: mahimaa kahee na jai gur samarath dhev ||
verses.translation: The Glory of the all-powerful Divine Guru cannot be described.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: gur paarabraham paramesur apara(n)par alakh abhev ||16||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, infinite, unseen and unknowable. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਕਮਾਵਦਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: audham karedhiaa jeeau too(n) kamaavadhiaa sukh bhu(n)ch ||
verses.translation: Make the effort, and you shall live; practicing it, you shall enjoy peace.

verses.original: ਧਿਆਇਦਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhiaaidhiaa too(n) prabhoo mil naanak utaree chi(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating, you shall meet God, O Nanak, and your anxiety shall vanish. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: subh chi(n)tan gobi(n)dh raman niramal saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Bless me with sublime thoughts, O Lord of the Universe, and contemplation in the immaculate Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na visarau ik ghaRee kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for even an instant; be merciful to me, Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: teraa keetaa hoi ta kaahe ddarapeeaai ||
verses.translation: Whatever happens is according to Your Will, so why should I be afraid?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੀਉ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis mil japeeaai naau tis jeeau arapeeaai ||
verses.translation: Meeting Him, I meditate on the Name - I offer my soul to Him.

verses.original: ਆਇਐ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaai chit nihaal saahib besumaar ||
verses.translation: When the Infinite Lord comes to mind, one is enraptured.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੋਹੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tis no pohe kavan jis val nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Who can touch one who has the Formless Lord on his side?

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh tis kai vas na koiee baaharaa ||
verses.translation: Everything is under His control; no one is beyond Him.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: so bhagataa man vuThaa sach samaaharaa ||
verses.translation: He, the True Lord, dwells in the minds of His devotees.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tere dhaas dhiaain tudh too(n) rakhan vaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Your slaves meditate on You; You are the Savior, the Protector Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: sir sabhanaa samarath nadhar nihaaliaa ||17||
verses.translation: You are the Almighty Overlord of all; You bless us with Your Glance of Grace. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਸਟ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh madh lobh moh dhusaT baasanaa nivaar ||
verses.translation: Take away my sexual desire, anger, pride, greed, emotional attachment and evil desires.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raakh leh prabh aapane naanak sadh balihaar ||1||
verses.translation: Protect me, O my God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਘਠਾ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: khaa(n)dhiaa khaa(n)dhiaa muh ghaThaa paina(n)dhiaa sabh a(n)g ||
verses.translation: By eating and eating, the mouth is worn out; by wearing clothes, the limbs grow weary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhirag tinaa dhaa jeeviaa jin sach na lago ra(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, cursed are the lives of those who are not attuned to the Love of the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਹੋਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau teraa hukam tivai tiau hovanaa ||
verses.translation: As is the Hukam of Your Command, so do things happen.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਰਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ਖੜੋਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh rakheh aap teh jai khaRovanaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever You keep me, there I go and stand.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੋਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam terai kai ra(n)g dhuramat dhovanaa ||
verses.translation: With the Love of Your Name, I wash away my evil-mindedness.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap tudh nira(n)kaar bharam bhau khovanaa ||
verses.translation: By continually meditating on You, O Formless Lord, my doubts and fears are dispelled.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo terai ra(n)g rate se jon na jovanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to Your Love, shall not be trapped in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar ik nain alovanaa ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, they behold the One Lord with their eyes.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰੋਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee pachhaataa hukam tin(h) kadhe na rovanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who recognize the Lord's Command never weep.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਰੋਵਣਾ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naau naanak bakhasees man maeh parovanaa ||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are blessed with the gift of the Name, woven into the fabric of their minds. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੁਆ ਰਲੰਦੜੋ ਖਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: jeevadhiaa na chetio muaa rala(n)dhaRo khaak ||
verses.translation: Those who do not remember the Lord while they are alive, shall mix with the dust when they die.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਦਾਰਿਆ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਪਾਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhuneeaa sa(n)g gudhaariaa saakat mooR napaak ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the foolish and filthy faithless cynic passes his life engrossed in the world. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਮਰੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeeva(n)dhiaa har chetiaa mara(n)dhiaa har ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: One who remembers the Lord while he is alive, shall be imbued with the Lord's Love when he dies.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath taariaa naanak saadhoo sa(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: The precious gift of his life is redeemed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee aap rakhan vaaliaa ||
verses.translation: From the beginning, and through the ages, You have been our Protector and Preserver.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach naam karataar sach pasaariaa ||
verses.translation: True is Your Name, O Creator Lord, and True is Your Creation.

verses.original: ਊਣਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: uoonaa kahee na hoi ghaTe ghaT saariaa ||
verses.translation: You do not lack anything; You are filling each and every heart.

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: miharavaan samarath aape hee ghaaliaa ||
verses.translation: You are merciful and all-powerful; You Yourself cause us to serve You.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) man vuThaa aap se sadhaa sukhaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds in which You dwell are forever at peace.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape rachan rachai aape hee paaliaa ||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, You Yourself cherish it.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap bea(n)t apaariaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are everything, O infinite, endless Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee Tek naanak sa(n)m(h)aaliaa ||19||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Protection and Support of the Perfect Guru. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aadh madh ar a(n)t paramesar rakhiaa ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, the Transcendent Lord has saved me.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhitaa har naam a(n)mrit chakhiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has blessed me with the Lord's Name, and I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhaa sa(n)g apaar anadhin har gun ravai ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

verses.original: ਪਾਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਭਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: paae manorath sabh jonee neh bhavai ||
verses.translation: I have obtained all my objectives, and I shall not wander in reincarnation again.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh karate hath kaaran jo karai ||
verses.translation: Everything is in the Hands of the Creator; He does what is done.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)gai dhaan sa(n)taa dhoor tarai ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Holy, which shall deliver him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis no ma(n)n vasai jin upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Enshrine Him in your mind, the One who created you.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin jan dhiaaiaa khasam tin sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on the Lord and Master obtains peace.

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam paravaan gurmukh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the birth, and approved is the coming of the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hukamai bujh nihaal khasam furamaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command shall be blessed - so has the Lord and Master ordained.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਨਹ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis hoaa aap kirapaalu su neh bharamaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy does not wander.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਸਮਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo dhitaa khasam soiee sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord and Master gives him, with that he is content.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jiseh dhiaal bujhaae hukam mit ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the kindness of the Lord, our Friend, realizes the Hukam of His Command.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiseh bhulaae aap mar mar jameh nit ||2||
verses.translation: But those whom the Lord Himself causes to wander, continue to die, and take reincarnation again. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਤਕਾਲਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਣ ਨ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak maare tatakaal khin Tikan na dhite ||
verses.translation: The slanderers are destroyed in an instant; they are not spared for even a moment.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਖਵਿ ਸਕਹਿ ਫੜਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhaas kaa dhukh na khav sakeh faR jonee jute ||
verses.translation: God will not endure the sufferings of His slaves, but catching the slanderers, He binds them to the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਮਥੇ ਵਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: mathe vaal pachhaaRian jam maarag mute ||
verses.translation: Grabbing them by the hair on their heads, the Lord throws them down, and leaves them on the path of Death.

verses.original: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਣਿਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh lagai bilalaaniaa narak ghor sute ||
verses.translation: They cry out in pain, in the darkest of hells.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lai dhaas rakhian naanak har sate ||20||
verses.translation: But hugging His slaves close to His Heart, O Nanak, the True Lord saves them. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam japahu vaddabhaageeho jal thal pooran soi ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, O fortunate ones; He is pervading the waters and the earth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaiaai bighan na laagai koi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and no misfortune shall strike you. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT bighan tis laagate jis no visarai naau ||
verses.translation: Millions of misfortunes block the way of one who forgets the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak anadhin bilapate jiau su(n)n(j)ai ghar kaau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, like a crow in a deserted house, he cries out, night and day. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar dhaataar manorath pooriaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance of the Great Giver, one's heart's desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਗਏ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eichh pu(n)nee man aas ge visooriaa ||
verses.translation: The hopes and desires of the mind are realized, and sorrows are forgotten.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਲਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa naam nidhaan jis no bhaaladhaa ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained; I have searched for it for so long.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਾਲਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jot milee sa(n)g jot rahiaa ghaaladhaa ||
verses.translation: My light is merged into the Light, and my labors are over.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਵੁਠੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh vuThe tit ghar ||
verses.translation: I abide in that house of peace, poise and bliss.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਤਹਾ ਮਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahe janam na tahaa mar ||
verses.translation: My comings and goings have ended - there is no birth or death there.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saahib sevak ik ik dhirasaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Master and the servant have become one, with no sense of separation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧॥੨॥ ਸੁਧੁ
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak sach samaiaa ||21||1||2|| sudhu
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak is absorbed in the True Lord. ||21||1||2||Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ
verses.translit: raag goojaree bhagataa kee baanee
verses.translation: Raag Goojaree, The Words Of The Devotees:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਚਉਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: sree kabeer jeeau kaa chaupadhaa ghar doojaa dhoojaa ||
verses.translation: Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee, Second House:

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਾਵ ਦੁਇ ਸਿੰਗ ਗੁੰਗ ਮੁਖ ਤਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਈਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: chaar paav dhui si(n)g gu(n)g mukh tab kaise gun gieehai ||
verses.translation: With four feet, two horns and a mute mouth, how could you sing the Praises of the Lord?

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਠੇਗਾ ਪਰਿਹੈ ਤਬ ਕਤ ਮੂਡ ਲੁਕਈਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat Thegaa parihai tab kat moodd lukieehai ||1||
verses.translation: Standing up and sitting down, the stick shall still fall on you, so where will you hide your head? ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੁਈਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: har bin bail biraane huieehai ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, you are like a stray ox;

verses.original: ਫਾਟੇ ਨਾਕਨ ਟੂਟੇ ਕਾਧਨ ਕੋਦਉ ਕੋ ਭੁਸੁ ਖਈਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: faaTe naakan TooTe kaadhan kodhau ko bhus khieehai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: with your nose torn, and your shoulders injured, you shall have only the straw of coarse grain to eat. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਬਨ ਮਹੀਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਪੇਟ ਅਘਈਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: saaro dhin ddolat ban maheeaa ajahu na peT aghieehai ||
verses.translation: All day long, you shall wander in the forest, and even then, your belly will not be full.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੋ ਕਹੋ ਨ ਮਾਨੋ ਕੀਓ ਅਪਨੋ ਪਈਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan bhagatan ko kaho na maano keeo apano pieehai ||2||
verses.translation: You did not follow the advice of the humble devotees, and so you shall obtain the fruits of your actions. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਬੂਡੋ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਈਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh karat mahaa bhram booddo anik jon bharamieehai ||
verses.translation: Enduring pleasure and pain, drowned in the great ocean of doubt, you shall wander in numerous reincarnations.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਪਈਹੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ratan janam khoio prabh bisario ih aausar kat pieehai ||3||
verses.translation: You have lost the jewel of human birth by forgetting God; when will you have such an opportunity again? ||3||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੇਲਕ ਕੇ ਕਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਈਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhramat firat telak ke kap jiau gat bin rain bihieehai ||
verses.translation: You turn on the wheel of reincarnation, like an ox at the oil-press; the night of your life passes away without salvation.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਧੁਨੇ ਪਛੁਤਈਹੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer raam naam bin moo(n)dd dhune pachhutieehai ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the Lord, you shall pound your head, and regret and repent. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, Third House:

verses.original: ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mus mus rovai kabeer kee maiee ||
verses.translation: Kabeer's mother sobs, cries and bewails

verses.original: ਏ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e baarik kaise jeeveh raghuraiee ||1||
verses.translation: - O Lord, how will my grandchildren live? ||1||

verses.original: ਤਨਨਾ ਬੁਨਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਤਜਿਓ ਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: tananaa bunanaa sabh tajio hai kabeer ||
verses.translation: Kabeer has given up all his spinning and weaving,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam likh leeo sareer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and written the Name of the Lord on his body. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਬਾਹਉ ਬੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag taagaa baahau behee ||
verses.translation: As long as I pass the thread through the bobbin,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tab lag bisarai raam sanehee ||2||
verses.translation: I forget the Lord, my Beloved. ||2||

verses.original: ਓਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: ochhee mat meree jaat julaahaa ||
verses.translation: My intellect is lowly - I am a weaver by birth,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹਿਓ ਮੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam lahio mai laahaa ||3||
verses.translation: but I have earned the profit of the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu meree maiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mother

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਇਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: hamaraa in kaa dhaataa ek raghuraiee ||4||2||
verses.translation: - the Lord alone is the Provider, for me and my children. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: goojaree sree naamadhev jee ke padhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Padhay Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੌ ਰਾਜੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jau raaj dheh ta kavan baddaiee ||
verses.translation: If You gave me an empire, then what glory would be in it for me?

verses.original: ਜੌ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਵਹਿ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jau bheekh ma(n)gaaveh ta kiaa ghaT jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: If You made me beg for charity, what would it take away from me? ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) har bhaj man mere padh nirabaan ||
verses.translation: Meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, O my mind, and you shall obtain the state of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bahur na hoi teraa aavan jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation any longer. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੈ ਉਪਾਈ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tai upaiee bharam bhulaiee ||
verses.translation: You created all, and You lead them astray in doubt.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) dheveh tiseh bujhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: They alone understand, unto whom You give understanding. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta sahasaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, doubt is dispelled.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਪੂਜਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kis hau poojau dhoojaa nadhar na aaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Who else should I worship? I can see no other. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕੈ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਜੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ekai paathar keejai bhaau ||
verses.translation: One stone is lovingly decorated,

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਾਥਰ ਧਰੀਐ ਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai paathar dhareeaai paau ||
verses.translation: while another stone is walked upon.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਉ ਤ ਓਹੁ ਭੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: je oh dheau ta oh bhee dhevaa ||
verses.translation: If one is a god, then the other must also be a god.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh naamadheau ham har kee sevaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, I serve the Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Goojaree, First House:

verses.original: ਮਲੈ ਨ ਲਾਛੈ ਪਾਰ ਮਲੋ ਪਰਮਲੀਓ ਬੈਠੋ ਰੀ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: malai na laachhai paar malo paramaleeo baiTho ree aaiee ||
verses.translation: He does not have even a trace of impurity - He is beyond impurity. He is fragrantly scented - He has come to take His Seat in my mind.

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਕਵਨੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavat kinai na pekhio kavanai jaanai ree baiee ||1||
verses.translation: No one saw Him come - who can know Him, O Siblings of Destiny? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਿਣਿ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਕੁਲੁ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaun kahai kin boojheeaai ramieeaa aakul ree baiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Who can describe Him? Who can understand Him? The all-pervading Lord has no ancestors, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਆਕਾਸੈ ਪੰਖੀਅਲੋ ਖੋਜੁ ਨਿਰਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau aakaasai pa(n)kheealo khoj nirakhio na jaiee ||
verses.translation: As the path of a bird's flight across the sky cannot be seen,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਾਝੈ ਮਾਛਲੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੇਖਣੋ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau jal maajhai maachhalo maarag pekhano na jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: and the path of a fish through the water cannot be seen;||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਆਕਾਸੈ ਘੜੂਅਲੋ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau aakaasai ghaRooalo mirag tirasanaa bhariaa ||
verses.translation: As the mirage leads one to mistake the sky for a pitcher filled with water

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਚੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੀਨੈ ਜਰਿਆ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: naame che suaamee beeThalo jin teenai jariaa ||3||2||
verses.translation: - so is God, the Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, who fits these three comparisons. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: goojaree sree ravidhaas jee ke padhe ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Padhay Of Ravi Daas Jee, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੂਧੁ ਤ ਬਛਰੈ ਥਨਹੁ ਬਿਟਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: dhoodh ta bachharai thanahu biTaario ||
verses.translation: The calf has contaminated the milk in the teats.

verses.original: ਫੂਲੁ ਭਵਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਮੀਨਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: fool bhavar jal meen bigaario ||1||
verses.translation: The bumble bee has contaminated the flower, and the fish the water. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਰਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: maiee gobi(n)dh poojaa kahaa lai charaavau ||
verses.translation: O mother, where shall I find any offering for the Lord's worship?

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar na fool anoop na paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot find any other flowers worthy of the incomparable Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਬੇਰ੍ਹੇ ਹੈ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: mailaagar berhe hai bhuia(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: The snakes encircle the sandalwood trees.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bikh a(n)mrit baseh ik sa(n)gaa ||2||
verses.translation: Poison and nectar dwell there together. ||2||

verses.original: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਨਈਬੇਦਹਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoop dheep nieebedheh baasaa ||
verses.translation: Even with incense, lamps, offerings of food and fragrant flowers,

verses.original: ਕੈਸੇ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaise pooj kareh teree dhaasaa ||3||
verses.translation: how are Your slaves to worship You? ||3||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਪੂਜ ਚਰਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man arapau pooj charaavau ||
verses.translation: I dedicate and offer my body and mind to You.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh nira(n)jan paavau ||4||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I attain the immaculate Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa arachaa aaeh na toree ||
verses.translation: I cannot worship You, nor offer You flowers.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh ravidhaas kavan gat moree ||5||1||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, what shall my condition be hereafter? ||5||1||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: goojaree sree tiralochan jeeau ke padhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Padhay Of Trilochan Jee, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mal niramal nahee keenaa baahar bhekh udhaasee ||
verses.translation: You have not cleansed the filth from within yourself, although outwardly, you wear the dress of a renunciate.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hiradhai kamal ghaT braham na cheen(h)aa kaahe bhiaa sa(n)niaasee ||1||
verses.translation: In the heart-lotus of your self, you have not recognized God - why have you become a Sannyaasee? ||1||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੀ ਰੇ ਜੈ ਚੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: bharame bhoolee re jai cha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, O Jai Chand,

verses.original: ਨਹੀ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nahee nahee cheeni(h)aa paramaana(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: you have not realized the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਧਾਇਆ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar khaiaa pi(n)dd badhaiaa khi(n)thaa mu(n)dhaa maiaa ||
verses.translation: You eat in each and every house, fattening your body; you wear the patched coat and the ear-rings of the beggar, for the sake of wealth.

verses.original: ਭੂਮਿ ਮਸਾਣ ਕੀ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhoom masaan kee bhasam lagaiee gur bin tat na paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: You apply the ashes of cremation to your body, but without a Guru, you have not found the essence of reality. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਇ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ ਤਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kai japahu re kai tapahu re kai bilovahu paanee ||
verses.translation: Why bother to chant your spells? Why bother to practice austerities? Why bother to churn water?

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿੑ ਉਪਾਈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh jini(h) upaiee so simarahu nirabaanee ||3||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa, who has created the 8.4 million species of beings. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਇ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਕਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kai kama(n)ddal kaapaReeaa re aThasaTh kai firaahee ||
verses.translation: Why bother to carry the water-pot, O saffron-robed Yogi? Why bother to visit the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage?

verses.original: ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਣ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਹੁ ਕਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: badhat tiralochan sun re praanee kan bin gaahu k paahee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Trilochan, listen, mortal: you have no corn - what are you trying to thresh? ||4||1||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: goojaree ||
verses.translation: Goojaree:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲਛਮੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal jo lachhamee simarai aaisee chi(n)taa meh je marai ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of wealth, and dies in such thoughts,

verses.original: ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarap jon val val aautarai ||1||
verses.translation: shall be reincarnated over and over again, in the form of serpents. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਤਿ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aree baiee gobidh naam mat beesarai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: O sister, do not forget the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal jo isatree simarai aaisee chi(n)taa meh je marai ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, he who thinks of women, and dies in such thoughts,

verses.original: ਬੇਸਵਾ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: besavaa jon val val aautarai ||2||
verses.translation: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a prostitute. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲੜਿਕੇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal jo laRike simarai aaisee chi(n)taa meh je marai ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of his children, and dies in such thoughts,

verses.original: ਸੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sookar jon val val aautarai ||3||
verses.translation: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a pig. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal jo ma(n)dhar simarai aaisee chi(n)taa meh je marai ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of mansions, and dies in such thoughts,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pret jon val val aautarai ||4||
verses.translation: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a goblin. ||4||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal naarain simarai aaisee chi(n)taa meh je marai ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, one who thinks of the Lord, and dies in such thoughts,

verses.original: ਬਦਤਿ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਪੀਤੰਬਰੁ ਵਾ ਕੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: badhat tilochan te nar mukataa peeta(n)bar vaa ke ridhai basai ||5||2||
verses.translation: says Trilochan, that man shall be liberated; the Lord shall abide in his heart. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: goojaree sree jaidhev jeeau kaa padhaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Goojaree, Padhay Of Jai Dayv Jee, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਮਨੋਪਿਮੰ ਸਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਭਾਵ ਰਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: paramaadh purakhamanopima(n) sat aadh bhaav rata(n) ||
verses.translation: In the very beginning, was the Primal Lord, unrivalled, the Lover of Truth and other virtues.

verses.original: ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤੰ ਪਰਕ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਰੰ ਜਦਿਚਿੰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਗਤੰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paramadhabhuta(n) parakirat para(n) jadhichi(n)t sarab gata(n) ||1||
verses.translation: He is absolutely wonderful, transcending creation; remembering Him, all are emancipated. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮਨੋਰਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: keval raam naam manorama(n) ||
verses.translation: Dwell only upon the beauteous Name of the Lord,

verses.original: ਬਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਤ ਮਇਅੰ ॥
verses.translit: badh a(n)mirat tat mia(n) ||
verses.translation: the embodiment of ambrosial nectar and reality.

verses.original: ਨ ਦਨੋਤਿ ਜਸਮਰਣੇਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਰਾਧਿ ਮਰਣ ਭਇਅੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: n dhanot jasamaranen janam jaraadh maran bhia(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, the fear of birth, old age and death will not trouble you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਛਸਿ ਜਮਾਦਿ ਪਰਾਭਯੰ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਵਸਤਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
verses.translit: eichhas jamaadh paraabhaya(n) jas savaisat sukirat kirata(n) ||
verses.translation: If you desire to escape the fear of the Messenger of Death, then praise the Lord joyfully, and do good deeds.

verses.original: ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਭਾਵ ਸਮਬੵਿਅੰ ਪਰਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਮਿਦੰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhav bhoot bhaav samabiyea(n) parama(n) prasa(n)namidha(n) ||2||
verses.translation: In the past, present and future, He is always the same; He is the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਲੋਭਾਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੰ ਜਦਿਬਿਧਿ ਆਚਰਣੰ ॥
verses.translit: lobhaadh dhirasaT par giraha(n) jadhibidh aacharana(n) ||
verses.translation: If you seek the path of good conduct, forsake greed, and do not look upon other men's property and women.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਸਕਲ ਦੁਹਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਦੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਜੁ ਚਕ੍ਰਧਰ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taj sakal dhuhakirat dhuramatee bhaj chakaradhar sarana(n) ||3||
verses.translation: Renounce all evil actions and evil inclinations, and hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲਾ ਰਿਦ ਕਰਮਣਾ ਬਚਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagat nij nihakevalaa ridh karamanaa bachasaa ||
verses.translation: Worship the immaculate Lord, in thought, word and deed.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਜਗੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਦਾਨੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਤਪਸਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jogen ki(n) jagen ki(n) dhaanen ki(n) tapasaa ||4||
verses.translation: What is the good of practicing Yoga, giving feasts and charity, and practicing penance? ||4||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਰ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਦੰ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dhet jap nar sakal sidh padha(n) ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the Universe, O man; He is the source of all the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

verses.original: ਜੈਦੇਵ ਆਇਉ ਤਸ ਸਫੁਟੰ ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਸਰਬ ਗਤੰ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaidhev aaiau tas safuTa(n) bhav bhoot sarab gata(n) ||5||1||
verses.translation: Jai Dayv has openly come to Him; He is the salvation of all, in the past, present and future. ||5||1||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag dhevaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਬਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: sevak jan bane Thaakur liv laage ||
verses.translation: Those who become the humble servants of the Lord and Master, lovingly focus their minds on Him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo tumaraa jas kahate gurmat tin mukh bhaag sabhaage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who chant Your Praises, through the Guru's Teachings, have great good fortune recorded upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਟੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: TooTe maiaa ke ba(n)dhan faahe har raam naam liv laage ||
verses.translation: The bonds and shackles of Maya are shattered, by lovingly focusing their minds on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਹਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hamaraa man mohio gur mohan ham bisam bhiee mukh laage ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is enticed by the Guru, the Enticer; beholding Him, I am wonder-struck. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੋਈ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee rain soiee a(n)dhiaaree gur ki(n)chat kirapaa jaage ||
verses.translation: I slept through the entire dark night of my life, but through the tiniest bit of the Guru's Grace, I have been awakened.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke prabh su(n)dhar suaamee moh tum sar avar na laage ||2||1||
verses.translation: O Beautiful Lord God, Master of servant Nanak, there is none comparable to You. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਗਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: mero su(n)dhar kahahu milai kit galee ||
verses.translation: Tell me - on what path will I find my Beauteous Lord?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਹਮ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t bataavahu maarag ham peechhai laag chalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Saints of the Lord, show me the Way, and I shall follow. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਇਹ ਚਾਲ ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ਭਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: pria ke bachan sukhaane heearai ieh chaal banee hai bhalee ||
verses.translation: I cherish in my heart the Words of my Beloved; this is the best way.

verses.original: ਲਟੁਰੀ ਮਧੁਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਈ ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: laTuree madhuree Thaakur bhaiee oh su(n)dhar har ddul milee ||1||
verses.translation: The bride may be hunch-backed and short, but if she is loved by her Lord Master, she becomes beautiful, and she melts in the Lord's embrace. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਖੀਆ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: eko priau sakheeaa sabh pria kee jo bhaavai pir saa bhalee ||
verses.translation: There is only the One Beloved - we are all soul-brides of our Husband Lord. She who is pleasing to her Husband Lord is good.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gareeb kiaa karai bichaaraa har bhaavai tit raeh chalee ||2||2||
verses.translation: What can poor, helpless Nanak do? As it pleases the Lord, so does he walk. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere man mukh har har har boleeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭੀਨੀ ਚੋਲੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ra(n)g chaloolai raatee har prem bheenee choleeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of the poppy. His shawl is saturated with the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਦਿਵਾਨੀ ਆਵਲ ਬਾਵਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hau firau dhivaanee aaval baaval tis kaaran har ddoleeaai ||
verses.translation: I wander around here and there, like a madman, bewildered, seeking out my Darling Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗੁਲ ਗੋਲੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koiee melai meraa preetam piaaraa ham tis kee gul goleeaai ||1||
verses.translation: I shall be the slave of the slave of whoever unites me with my Darling Beloved. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਝੋਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh manaavahu apunaa har a(n)mrit pee jholeeaai ||
verses.translation: So align yourself with the Almighty True Guru; drink in and savor the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਦੇਹ ਟੋਲੀਐ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh jan naanak paiaa har laadhaa dheh Toleeaai ||2||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Lord within. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਚਲੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ab ham chalee Thaakur peh haar ||
verses.translation: Now, I have come, exhausted, to my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab ham saran prabhoo kee aaiee raakh prabhoo bhaavai maar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Now that I have come seeking Your Sanctuary, God, please, either save me, or kill me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: lokan kee chaturaiee upamaa te baisa(n)tar jaar ||
verses.translation: I have burnt in the fire the clever devices and praises of the world.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹਉ ਹਮ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਢਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koiee bhalaa kahau bhaavai buraa kahau ham tan dheeo hai ddaar ||1||
verses.translation: Some speak good of me, and some speak ill of me, but I have surrendered my body to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਆਵਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo aavat saran Thaakur prabh tumaree tis raakhahu kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: Whoever comes to Your Sanctuary, O God, Lord and Master, You save by Your Merciful Grace.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saran tumaaree har jeeau raakhahu laaj muraar ||2||4||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord; O Lord, please, protect his honor! ||2||4||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavai hau tis balihaaree ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh dhekh jeevaa saadh gur dharasan jis hiradhai naam muraaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I live by continuously beholding the Blessed Vision of the Holy Guru's Darshan; within His Mind is the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੂਠਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tum pavitr paavan purakh prabh suaamee ham kiau kar mileh jooThaaree ||
verses.translation: You are pure and immaculate, O God, Almighty Lord and Master; how can I, the impure one, meet You?

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hamarai jeei hor mukh hor hot hai ham karamaheen kooRiaaree ||1||
verses.translation: I have one thing in my mind, and another thing on my lips; I am such a poor, unfortunate liar! ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੁਸਟ ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hamaree mudhr naam har suaamee ridh a(n)tar dhusaT dhusaTaaree ||
verses.translation: I appear to chant the Lord's Name, but within my heart, I am the most wicked of the wicked.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu suaamee jan naanak saran tum(h)aaree ||2||5||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, save me, O Lord and Master; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||2||5||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਨਕਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam binaa su(n)dhar hai nakaTee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the beautiful are just like the noseless ones.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਪੂਤੁ ਜਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਕਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau besuaa ke ghar poot jamat hai tis naam pario hai dhrakaTee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Like the son, born into the house of a prostitute, his name is cursed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪ ਬੇਰਕਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai hiradhai naeh har suaamee te bigaR roop berakaTee ||
verses.translation: Those who do not have the Name of their Lord and Master within their hearts, are the most wretched, deformed lepers.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau niguraa bahu baataa jaanai oh har dharageh hai bhrasaTee ||1||
verses.translation: Like the person who has no Guru, they may know many things, but they are cursed in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਚਕਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau dhiaal hoaa meraa suaamee tinaa saadh janaa pag chakaTee ||
verses.translation: Those, unto whom my Lord Master becomes Merciful, long for the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਛੁਕਟੀ ॥੨॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧
verses.translit: naanak patit pavit mil sa(n)gat gur satigur paachhai chhukaTee ||2||6|| chhakaa 1
verses.translation: O Nanak, the sinners become pure, joining the Company of the Holy; following the Guru, the True Guru, they are emancipated. ||2||6|| First Set of Six||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: maiee gur charanee chit laieeaai ||
verses.translation: O mother, I focus my consciousness on the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh hoi kirapaal kamal paragaase sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As God shows His Mercy, the lotus of my heart blossoms, and forever and ever, I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar eko baahar eko sabh meh ek samaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is within, and the One Lord is outside; the One Lord is contained in all.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghaT avaghaT raviaa sabh Thaiee har pooran braham dhikhaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Within the heart, beyond the heart, and in all places, God, the Perfect One, is seen to be permeating. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat kareh sevak mun kete teraa a(n)t na katahoo paieeaai ||
verses.translation: So many of Your servants and silent sages sing Your Praises, but no one has found Your limits.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaate dhukh bha(n)jan suaamee jan naanak sadh bal jaieeaai ||2||1||
verses.translation: O Giver of peace, Destroyer of pain, Lord and Master - servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਸੋ ਹੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: maiee honahaar so hoieeaai ||
verses.translation: O mother, whatever is to be, shall be.

verses.original: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹਾ ਖੋਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raach rahio rachanaa prabh apanee kahaa laabh kahaa khoieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God pervades His pervading creation; one gains, while another loses. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਖੈ ਸੋਗ ਕਬ ਹਸਨੋ ਕਬ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: keh fooleh aana(n)dh bikhai sog kab hasano kab roieeaai ||
verses.translation: Sometimes he blossoms in bliss, while at other times, he suffers in mourning. Sometimes he laughs, and sometimes he weeps.

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕਬ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਧੋਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kabahoo mail bhare abhimaanee kab saadhoo sa(n)g dhoieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Sometimes he is filled with the filth of ego, while at other times, he washes it off in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਲੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: koi na meTai prabh kaa keeaa dhoosar naahee aloieeaai ||
verses.translation: No one can erase the actions of God; I cannot see any other like Him.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈਐ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree jeh prasaadh sukh soieeaai ||2||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru; by His Grace, I sleep in peace. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੋਚ ਭੈ ਡਰਤ ॥
verses.translit: maiee sunat soch bhai ddarat ||
verses.translation: O mother, I hear of death, and think of it, and I am filled with fear.

verses.original: ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਤਜਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਪਰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mer ter tajau abhimaanaa saran suaamee kee parat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Renouncing 'mine and yours' and egotism, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਨਾਹਿ ਨ ਕਾ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਤ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo kahai soiee bhal maanau naeh na kaa bol karat ||
verses.translation: Whatever He says, I accept that as good. I do not say ""No"" to what He says.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਜਾਈ ਹਉ ਮਰਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nimakh na bisarau he'ee more te bisarat jaiee hau marat ||1||
verses.translation: Let me not forget Him, even for an instant; forgetting Him, I die. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਇਆਨਪ ਜਰਤ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaiee pooran prabh karataa meree bahut iaanap jarat ||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace, God, the Perfect Creator, endures my great ignorance.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਕਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਹੀਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਰਤ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: niragun karoop kulaheen naanak hau anadh roop suaamee bharat ||2||3||
verses.translation: I am worthless, ugly and of low birth, O Nanak, but my Husband Lord is the embodiment of bliss. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਹੂੰ ॥
verses.translit: man har keerat kar sadhahoo(n) ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant forever the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਪਤ ਉਧਾਰੈ ਬਰਨ ਅਬਰਨਾ ਸਭਹੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gaavat sunat japat udhaarai baran abaranaa sabhahoo(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By singing, hearing and meditating on Him, all, whether of high or low status, are saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਤਬਹੂੰ ॥
verses.translit: jeh te upajio tahee samaio ieh bidh jaanee tabahoo(n) ||
verses.translation: He is absorbed into the One from which he originated, when he understands the Way.

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਇਹ ਦੇਹੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਬਹੂੰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jahaa jahaa ieh dhehee dhaaree rahan na paio kabahoo(n) ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever this body was fashioned, it was not allowed to remain there. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਆਇਓ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹੂਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਬਹੂ ॥
verses.translit: sukh aaio bhai bharam binaase kirapaal hooe prabh jabahoo ||
verses.translation: Peace comes, and fear and doubt are dispelled, when God becomes Merciful.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਜਿ ਲਬਹੂੰ ॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mere poore manorath saadhasa(n)g taj labahoo(n) ||2||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my hopes have been fulfilled, renouncing my greed in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||4||

verses.original: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhevaga(n)dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਜਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: man jiau apune prabh bhaavau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, act as it pleases God.

verses.original: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: neechahu neech neech at naan(h)aa hoi gareeb bulaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Become the lowest of the low, the very least of the tiny, and speak in utmost humility. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਘਟਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik adda(n)bar maiaa ke birathe taa siau preet ghaTaavau ||
verses.translation: The many ostentatious shows of Maya are useless; I withhold my love from these.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau apuno suaamee sukh maanai taa meh sobhaa paavau ||1||
verses.translation: As something pleases my Lord and Master, in that I find my glory. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
