verses.translit: naanak sukhadhaataa seviaa aape parakhanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I serve the Giver of Peace; He Himself is the Assessor. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh teriaa too sabhanaa raas ||
verses.translation: All beings are Yours; You are the wealth of all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too dheh tis sabh kichh milai koiee hor sareek naahee tudh paas ||
verses.translation: One unto whom You give, obtains everything; there is no one else to rival You.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: too iko dhaataa sabhas dhaa har peh aradhaas ||
verses.translation: You alone are the Great Giver of all; I offer my prayer unto You, Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੂ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhee tudh bhaavai tis dhee too ma(n)n laih so jan saabaas ||
verses.translation: One with whom You are pleased, is accepted by You; how blessed is such a person!

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh teraa choj varatadhaa dhukh sukh tudh paas ||2||
verses.translation: Your wondrous play is pervading everywhere. I place my pain and pleasure before You. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sachai bhaavadhe dhar sachai sachiaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are pleasing to the True Lord; they are judged to be true in the True Court.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: saajan man aana(n)dh hai gur kaa sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The minds of such friends are filled with bliss, as they reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh vasaiaa dhukh kaTiaa chaanan keeaa karataar ||
verses.translation: They enshrine the Shabad within their hearts; their pain is dispelled, and the Creator blesses them with the Divine Light.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਖਸੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak rakhanahaaraa rakhasee aapanee kirapaa dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Savior Lord shall save them, and shower them with His Mercy. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa chaakaree bhai rach kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: Serve the Guru, and wait upon Him; as you work, maintain the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa sevai teho hovai je chalai tisai rajai ||
verses.translation: As you serve Him, you will become like Him, as you walk according to His Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh kichh aap hai avar na dhoojee jai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself is everything; there is no other place to go. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: teree vaddiaaiee toohai jaanadhaa tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your greatness - no one else is as great as You.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd hor sareek hovai taa aakheeaai tudh jevadd toohai hoiee ||
verses.translation: If there were some other rival as great as You, then I would speak of him. You alone are as great as You are.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin too seviaa tin sukh paiaa hor tis dhee rees kare kiaa koiee ||
verses.translation: One who serves You obtains peace; who else can compare to You?

verses.original: ਤੂ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ ਮੰਗਣ ਨੋ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਖਲੀ ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath dhaataar heh tudh agai ma(n)gan no hath joR khalee sabh hoiee ||
verses.translation: You are all-powerful to destroy and create, O Great Giver; with palms pressed together, all stand begging before You.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਸੈ ਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਖੰਡੀ ਵਰਭੰਡੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਪੁਰਈ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd dhaataar mai koiee nadhar na aaviee tudh sabhasai no dhaan dhitaa kha(n)ddee varabha(n)ddee paataalee puriee sabh loiee ||3||
verses.translation: I see none as great as You, O Great Giver; You give in charity to the beings of all the continents, worlds, solar systems, nether regions and universes. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man parateet na aaieeaa sahaj na lago bhaau ||
verses.translation: O mind, you have no faith, and you have not embraced love for the Celestial Lord;

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai saadh na paio manahaTh kiaa gun gai ||
verses.translation: you do not enjoy the sublime taste of the Word of the Shabad - what Praises of the Lord will you stubborn-mindedly sing?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aaiaa so paravaan hai j gurmukh sach samai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, his coming alone is approved, who, as Gurmukh, merges into the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਦੁਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa aap na pachhaanai mooRaa avaraa aakh dhukhaae ||
verses.translation: The fool does not understand his own self; he annoys others with his speech.

verses.original: ਮੁੰਢੈ ਦੀ ਖਸਲਤਿ ਨ ਗਈਆ ਅੰਧੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)ddai dhee khasalat na gieeaa a(n)dhe vichhuR choTaa khaae ||
verses.translation: His underlying nature does not leave him; separated from the Lord, he suffers cruel blows.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੰਨਿ ਨ ਘੜਿਓ ਰਹੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhai bha(n)n na ghaRio rahai a(n)k samaae ||
verses.translation: Through the fear of the True Guru, he has not changed and reformed himself, so that he might merge in the lap of God.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin sahasaa kadhe na chookai bin sabadhai dhukh paae ||
verses.translation: Night and day, his doubts never stop; without the Word of the Shabad, he suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh a(n)tar sabalaa nit dha(n)dhaa karat vihaae ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and greed are so powerful within him; he passes his life constantly entangled in worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਥਕੇ ਦਿਹ ਮੁਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: charan kar dhekhat sun thake dheh muke neRai aae ||
verses.translation: His feet, hands, eyes and ears are exhausted; his days are numbered, and his death is immanent.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਮੀਠਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa naam na lago meeThaa jit naam nav nidh paae ||
verses.translation: The True Name does not seem sweet to him - the Name by which the nine treasures are obtained.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai marai fun jeevai taa(n) mokha(n)tar paae ||
verses.translation: But if he remains dead while yet alive, then by so dying, he truly lives; thus, he attains liberation.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhur karam na paio paraanee vin karamaa kiaa paae ||
verses.translation: But if he is not blessed with such pre-ordained karma, then without this karma, what can he obtain?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh samaal too mooRe gat mat sabadhe paae ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you fool; through the Shabad, you shall obtain salvation and wisdom.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur tadh hee paae jaa(n) vichahu aap gavaae ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone finds the True Guru, who eliminates self-conceit from within. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਗਲੈ ਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhai chit vasiaa meraa suaamee tis no kiau a(n)dhesaa kisai galai dhaa loReeaai ||
verses.translation: One whose consciousness is filled with my Lord Master - why should he feel anxious about anything?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਕਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਧਿਆਇਦਿਆ ਕਿਵ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har sukhadhaataa sabhanaa galaa kaa tis no dhiaaidhiaa kiv nimakh ghaRee muh moReeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Giver of Peace, the Lord of all things; why would we turn our faces away from His meditation, even for a moment, or an instant?

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਤ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jin har dhiaaiaa tis no sarab kaliaan hoe nit sa(n)t janaa kee sa(n)gat jai baheeaai muh joReeaai ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the Lord obtains all pleasures and comforts; let us go each and every day, to sit in the Saints' Society.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhukh bhukh rog ge har sevak ke sabh jan ke ba(n)dhan toReeaai ||
verses.translation: All the pain, hunger, and disease of the Lord's servant are eradicated; the bonds of the humble beings are torn away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa te hoaa har bhagat har bhagat janaa kai muh ddiThai jagat tariaa sabh loReeaai ||4||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Grace, one becomes the Lord's devotee; beholding the face of the Lord's humble devotee, the whole world is saved and carried across. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saa rasanaa jal jaau jin har kaa suaau na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Let that tongue, which has not tasted the Name of the Lord, be burnt.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak rasanaa sabadh rasai jin har har ma(n)n vasaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his tongue savors the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saa rasanaa jal jaau jin har kaa naau visaariaa ||
verses.translation: Let that tongue, which has forgotten the Name of the Lord, be burnt.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh rasanaa har japai har kai nai piaariaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the tongue of the Gurmukh chants the Lord's Name, and loves the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har aape Thaakur sevak bhagat har aape kare karaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the Master, the servant and the devotee; the Lord Himself is the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har aape vekhai vigasai aape jit bhaavai tit laae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices. As He wills, so does He enjoin us.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har ikanaa maarag paae aape har ikanaa ujhaR paae ||
verses.translation: The Lord places some on the Path, and the Lord leads others into the wilderness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har sachaa saahib sach tapaavas kar vekhai chalat sabaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the True Master; True is His justice. He arranges and beholds all His plays.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh kahai jan naanak har sache ke gun gaae ||5||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak speaks and sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਕੋ ਜਾਣਸੀ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharavesee ko jaanasee viralaa ko dharaves ||
verses.translation: How rare is the dervish, the Saintly renunciate, who understands renunciation.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੰਢੈ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਧਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: je ghar ghar ha(n)ddai ma(n)gadhaa dhig jeevan dhig ves ||
verses.translation: Cursed is the life, and cursed are the clothes, of one who wanders around, begging from door to door.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je aasaa a(n)dhesaa taj rahai gurmukh bhikhiaa naau ||
verses.translation: But, if he abandons hope and anxiety, and as Gurmukh receives the Name as his charity,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis ke charan pakhaale'eeh naanak hau balihaarai jaau ||1||
verses.translation: then Nanak washes his feet, and is a sacrifice to him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਫਲੁ ਦੁਇ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਆਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak taravar ek fal dhui pa(n)kheroo aaeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the tree has one fruit, but two birds are perched upon it.

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਦੀਸਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aavat jaat na dheesahee naa par pa(n)khee taeh ||
verses.translation: They are not seen coming or going; these birds have no wings.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: bahu ra(n)gee ras bhogiaa sabadh rahai nirabaan ||
verses.translation: One enjoys so many pleasures, while the other, through the Word of the Shabad, remains in Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਫਲਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ras fal raate naanakaa karam sachaa neesaan ||2||
verses.translation: Imbued with the subtle essence of the fruit of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, the soul bears the True Insignia of God's Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape dharatee aape hai raahak aap ja(n)mai peesaavai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the field, and He Himself is the farmer. He Himself grows and grinds the corn.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਪਕਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਰੋਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਹਿ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap pakaavai aap bhaa(n)dde dhei parosai aape hee beh khaavai ||
verses.translation: He Himself cooks it, He Himself puts the food in the dishes, and He Himself sits down to eat.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਛਿੰਗਾ ਆਪੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape jal aape dhe chhi(n)gaa aape chulee bharaavai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the water, He Himself gives the tooth-pick, and He Himself offers the mouthwash.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਿ ਬਹਾਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape sa(n)gat sadh bahaalai aape vidhaa karaavai ||
verses.translation: He Himself calls and seats the congregation, and He Himself bids them goodbye.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaal hovai har aape tis no hukam manaavai ||6||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy - the Lord causes him to walk according to His Will. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam sabh ba(n)dhanaa paap pu(n)n sanaba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Rituals and religions are all just entanglements; bad and good are bound up with them.

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੁ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: mamataa mohu su ba(n)dhanaa putr kalatr su dha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Those things done for the sake of children and spouse, in ego and attachment, are just more bonds.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh jevaree maiaa kaa sanaba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see the noose of attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam bin varatan varatai a(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, the world is engrossed in blind entanglements. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe chaanan taa theeaai jaa satigur milai rajai ||
verses.translation: The blind receive the Divine Light, when they merge with the Will of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan toRai sach vasai agiaan adheraa jai ||
verses.translation: They break their bonds, and dwell in Truth, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh dhekhai tisai kaa jin keeaa tan saaj ||
verses.translation: They see that everything belongs to the One who created and fashioned the body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saran karataar kee karataa raakhai laaj ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Creator - the Creator preserves his honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਟੁ ਕੀਆ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਤਦਹੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਬੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jadhahu aape thaaT keeaa beh karatai tadhahu puchh na sevak beeaa ||
verses.translation: When the Creator, sitting all by Himself, created the Universe, he did not consult with any of His servants;

verses.original: ਤਦਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tadhahu kiaa ko levai kiaa ko dhevai jaa(n) avar na dhoojaa keeaa ||
verses.translation: so what can anyone take, and what can anyone give, when He did not create any other like Himself?

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: fir aape jagat upaiaa karatai dhaan sabhanaa kau dheeaa ||
verses.translation: Then, after fashioning the world, the Creator blessed all with His blessings.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਬਣਾਈਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape sev banaieean gurmukh aape a(n)mrit peeaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself instructs us in His service, and as Gurmukh, we drink in His Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aap nira(n)kaar aakaar hai aape aape karai su theeaa ||7||
verses.translation: He Himself is formless, and He Himself is formed; whatever He Himself does, comes to pass. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh prabh seveh sadh saachaa anadhin sahaj piaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs serve God forever; night and day, they are steeped in the Love of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਰਧਿ ਉਰਧਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh gaaveh gun saache aradh uradh ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: They are in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; in this world and in the next, they keep Him clasped to their hearts.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar preetam vasiaa dhur karam likhiaa karataar ||
verses.translation: Their Beloved dwells deep within; the Creator pre-ordained this destiny.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aap milaian aape kirapaa dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He blends them into Himself; He Himself showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਹਿਐ ਕਥਿਐ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahiaai kathiaai na paieeaai anadhin rahai sadhaa gun gai ||
verses.translation: By merely talking and speaking, He is not found. Night and day, sing His Glorious Praises continually.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin karamai kinai na paio bhauk mue bilalai ||
verses.translation: Without His Merciful Grace, no one finds Him; many have died barking and bewailing.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਿਜੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh man tan bhijai aap vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: When the mind and body are saturated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord Himself comes to dwell in his mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee paieeaai aape le milai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, He is found; He unites us in His Union. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਥੈ ਆਪਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape vedh puraan sabh saasat aap kathai aap bheejai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Vedas, the Puraanas and all the Shaastras; He Himself chants them, and He Himself is pleased.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਹਿ ਪੂਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee beh pooje karataa aap parapa(n)ch kareejai ||
verses.translation: He Himself sits down to worship, and He Himself creates the world.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap paravirat aap niraviratee aape akath katheejai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is a householder, and He Himself is a renunciate; He Himself utters the Unutterable.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape pu(n)n sabh aap karaae aap alipat varateejai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is all goodness, and He Himself causes us to act; He Himself remains detached.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aape sukh dhukh dhevai karataa aape bakhas kareejai ||8||
verses.translation: He Himself grants pleasure and pain; the Creator Himself bestows His gifts. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇਖਾ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਭਉ ਕਰਿ ਝਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sekhaa a(n)dharahu jor chhadd too bhau kar jhal gavai ||
verses.translation: O Shaykh, abandon your cruel nature; live in the Fear of God and give up your madness.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhai kete nisatare bhai vich nirabhau pai ||
verses.translation: Through the Fear of the Guru, many have been saved; in this fear, find the Fearless Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: man kaThor sabadh bhedh too(n) saa(n)t vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Pierce your stone heart with the Word of the Shabad; let peace and tranquility come to abide in your mind.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)tee vich kaar kamaavanee saa khasam paae thai ||
verses.translation: If good deeds are done in this state of peace, they are approved by the Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaam karodh kinai na paio puchhahu giaanee jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through sexual desire and anger, no one has ever found God - go, and ask any wise man. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh maiaa moh hai naam na lago piaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is emotionally attached to Maya - he has no love for the Naam.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kamaavai kooR sa(n)grahai kooR kare aahaar ||
verses.translation: He practices falsehood, gathers in falsehood, and makes falsehood his sustenance.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bikh maiaa dhan sa(n)ch mareh a(n)te hoi sabh chhaar ||
verses.translation: He collects the poisonous wealth of Maya, and then dies; in the end, it is all reduced to ashes.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam such sa(n)jam kareh a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
verses.translation: He practices religious rituals, purity and austere self-discipline, but within, there is greed and corruption.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਥਾਇ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak j manmukh kamaavai su thai naa pavai dharageh hoi khuaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever the self-willed manmukh does, is not acceptable; in the Court of the Lord, he is dishonored. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਖੰਡ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape khaanee aape baanee aape kha(n)dd varabha(n)dd kare ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the four sources of creation, and He Himself fashioned speech; He Himself formed the worlds and solar systems.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap samu(n)dh aap hai saagar aape hee vich ratan dhare ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the ocean, and He Himself is the sea; He Himself puts the pearls in it.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap lahaae kare jis kirapaa jis no gurmukh kare hare ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, the Lord enables the Gurmukh to find these pearls.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhaujal aap hai bohithaa aape khevaT aap tare ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the terrifying world-ocean, and He Himself is the boat; He Himself is the boatman, and He Himself ferries us across.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਰੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae karataa avar na dhoojaa tujhai sare ||9||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and causes us to act; no one else can equal You, Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa safal hai je ko kare chit lai ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is service to the True Guru, if one does so with a sincere mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath paieeaai achi(n)t vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam, is obtained, and the mind comes to be free of anxiety.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaTeeaai haumai mamataa jai ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, and the mind is rid of egotism and self-conceit.

verses.original: ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: autam padhavee paieeaai sache rahai samai ||
verses.translation: One achieves the ultimate state, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak poorab jin kau likhiaa tinaa satigur miliaa aai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam rataa satiguroo hai kalijug bohith hoi ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su paar pavai jinaa a(n)dhar sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh crosses over; the True Lord dwells within him.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam sam(h)aale naam sa(n)grahai naame hee pat hoi ||
verses.translation: He remembers the Naam, he gathers in the Naam, and he obtains honor through the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur paiaa karam paraapat hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak has found the True Guru; by His Grace, the Name is obtained. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape paaras aap dhaat hai aap keeton ka(n)chan ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Philosopher's Stone, He Himself is the metal, and He Himself is transformed into gold.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape Thaakur sevak aape aape hee paap kha(n)ddan ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master, He Himself is the servant, and He Himself is the Destroyer of sins.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sabh ghaT bhogavai suaamee aape hee sabh a(n)jan ||
verses.translation: He Himself enjoys every heart; the Lord Master Himself is the basis of all illusion.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੰਜਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap bibek aap sabh betaa aape gurmukh bha(n)jan ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the discerning one, and He Himself is the Knower of all; He Himself breaks the bonds of the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਨੁ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saalaeh na rajai tudh karate too har sukhadhaataa vaddan ||10||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is not satisfied by merely praising You, O Creator Lord; You are the Great Giver of peace. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve jeea ke ba(n)dhanaa jete karam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the deeds which are done are only chains binding the soul.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve Thavar na paavahee mar ja(n)meh aaveh jaeh ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, they find no place of rest. They die, only to be born again - they continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve fikaa bolanaa naam na vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, their speech is insipid. They do not enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bin satigur seve jam pur badhe maare'eh muh kaalai uTh jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and gagged, and beaten in the City of Death; they depart with blackened faces. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik satigur kee sevaa kareh chaakaree har naame lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: Some wait upon and serve the True Guru; they embrace love for the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak janam savaaran aapanaa kul kaa karan udhaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they reform their lives, and redeem their generations as well. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਚਾਟਸਾਲ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਧਾ ਆਪੇ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਪੜਣ ਕਉ ਆਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape chaaTasaal aap hai paadhaa aape chaaTaRe paRan kau aane ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the school, He Himself is the teacher, and He Himself brings the students to be taught.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape pitaa maataa hai aape aape baalak kare siaane ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the father, He Himself is the mother, and He Himself makes the children wise.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਇਕ ਥੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik thai paR bujhai sabh aape ik thai aape kare iaane ||
verses.translation: In one place, He teaches them to read and understand everything, while in another place, He Himself makes them ignorant.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa a(n)dhar mahal bulaae jaa aap terai man sache bhaane ||
verses.translation: Some, You summon to the Mansion of Your Presence within, when they are pleasing to Your Mind, O True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jinaa aape gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee se jan sachee dharageh jaane ||11||
verses.translation: That Gurmukh, whom You have blessed with greatness - that humble being is known in Your True Court. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok maradhaanaa 1 ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Mardaanaa:

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਮਦੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kal kalavaalee kaam madh manooaa peevanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the vessel, filled with the wine of sexual desire; the mind is the drunkard.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰੀ ਪੀਲਾਵਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karodh kaToree moh bharee peelaavaa aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Anger is the cup, filled with emotional attachment, and egotism is the server.

verses.original: ਮਜਲਸ ਕੂੜੇ ਲਬ ਕੀ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: majalas kooRe lab kee pee pee hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: Drinking too much in the company of falsehood and greed, one is ruined.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਸਤੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karanee laahan sat guR sach saraa kar saar ||
verses.translation: So let good deeds be your distillery, and Truth your molasses; in this way, make the most excellent wine of Truth.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਮੰਡੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਘਿਉ ਸਰਮੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gun ma(n)dde kar seel ghiau saram maas aahaar ||
verses.translation: Make virtue your bread, good conduct the ghee, and modesty the meat to eat.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਾਧੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paieeaai naanakaa khaadhai jaeh bikaar ||1||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, these are obtained, O Nanak; partaking of them, one's sins depart. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: maradhaanaa 1 ||
verses.translation: Mardaanaa:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਦੁ ਮਜਲਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa laahan aap madh majalas tirasanaa dhaat ||
verses.translation: The human body is the vat, self-conceit is the wine, and desire is the company of drinking buddies.

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਭਰੀ ਪੀਲਾਏ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa kaToree kooR bharee peelaae jamakaal ||
verses.translation: The cup of the mind's longing is overflowing with falsehood, and the Messenger of Death is the cup-bearer.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਮਦਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eit madh peetai naanakaa bahute khaTe'eeh bikaar ||
verses.translation: Drinking in this wine, O Nanak, one takes on countless sins and corruptions.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਮੰਡੇ ਭਉ ਮਾਸੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaan guR saalaeh ma(n)dde bhau maas aahaar ||
verses.translation: So make spiritual wisdom your molasses, the Praise of God your bread, and the Fear of God the meat you eat.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ih bhojan sach hai sach naam aadhaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this is the true food; let the True Name be your only Support. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਂਯਾਂ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)yaa(n) laahan aap madh a(n)mirat tis kee dhaar ||
verses.translation: If the human body is the vat, and self-realization is the wine, then a stream of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਿਵ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੀ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਕਟਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat siau melaap hoi liv kaToree a(n)mirat bharee pee pee kaTeh bikaar ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Society of the Saints, the cup of the Lord's Love is filled with this Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, one's corruptions and sins are wiped away. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬਾ ਆਪੇ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape sur nar gan ga(n)dharabaa aape khaT dharasan kee baanee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the angelic being, the heavenly herald, and the celestial singer. He Himself is the one who explains the six schools of philosophy.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਵ ਸੰਕਰ ਮਹੇਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape siv sa(n)kar mahesaa aape gurmukh akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is Shiva, Shankara and Mahaysh; He Himself is the Gurmukh, who speaks the Unspoken Speech.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape jogee aape bhogee aape sa(n)niaasee firai bibaanee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Yogi, He Himself is the Sensual Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Sannyaasee, wandering through the wilderness.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aapai naal gosaT aap upadhesai aape sughaR saroop siaanee ||
verses.translation: He discusses with Himself, and He teaches Himself; He Himself is discrete, graceful and wise.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: aapanaa choj kar vekhai aape aape sabhanaa jeeaa kaa hai jaanee ||12||
verses.translation: Staging His own play, He Himself watches it; He Himself is the Knower of all beings. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ehaa sa(n)dhiaa paravaan hai jit har prabh meraa chit aavai ||
verses.translation: That evening prayer alone is acceptable, which brings the Lord God to my consciousness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har siau preet uoopajai maiaa moh jalaavai ||
verses.translation: Love for the Lord wells up within me, and my attachment to Maya is burnt away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee dhubidhaa marai manooaa asathir sa(n)dhiaa kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, duality is conquered, and the mind becomes stable; I have made contemplative meditation my evening prayer.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)dhiaa karai manmukhee jeeau na Tikai mar ja(n)mai hoi khuaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh may recite his evening prayers, but his mind is not centered on it; through birth and death, he is ruined. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: priau priau karatee sabh jag firee meree piaas na jai ||
verses.translation: I wandered over the whole world, crying out, ""Love, O Love!"", but my thirst was not quenched.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਗਈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur miliaai meree piaas giee pir paiaa ghar aai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, my desires are satisfied; I found my Beloved, when I returned to my own home. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape ta(n)t param ta(n)t sabh aape aape Thaakur dhaas bhiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the supreme essence, He Himself is the essence of all. He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਸ ਅਠ ਵਰਨ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhas aTh varan upaian aap braham aap raaj liaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the people of the eighteen castes; God Himself acquired His domain.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape maare aape chhoddai aape bakhase kare dhiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself kills, and He Himself redeems; He Himself, in His Kindness, forgives us. He is infallible

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap abhul na bhulai kab hee sabh sach tapaavas sach thiaa ||
verses.translation: - He never errs; the justice of the True Lord is totally True.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: aape jinaa bujhaae gurmukh tin a(n)dharahu dhoojaa bharam giaa ||13||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs as Gurmukh - duality and doubt depart from within them. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਉਡੈ ਖੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: har naam na simareh saadhasa(n)g tai tan uddai kheh ||
verses.translation: That body, which does not remember the Lord's Name in meditation in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be reduced to dust.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਟੁ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin keetee tisai na jaaniee naanak fiT aloonee dheh ||1||
verses.translation: Cursed and insipid is that body, O Nanak, which does not know the One who created it. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੈ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT vaseh charanaarabi(n)dh rasanaa japai gupaal ||
verses.translation: Let the Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within your heart, and with your tongue, chant God's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so prabh simareeaai tis dhehee kau paal ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate in remembrance on God, and nurture this body. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape aThasaTh teerath karataa aap kare isanaan ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself is the sixty-eight sacred places of pilgrimage; He Himself takes the cleansing bath in them.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sa(n)jam varatai savaiaamee aap japaieh naam ||
verses.translation: He Himself practices austere self-discipline; the Lord Master Himself causes us to chant His Name.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap dhiaal hoi bhau kha(n)ddan aap karai sabh dhaan ||
verses.translation: He Himself becomes merciful to us; the Destroyer of fear Himself gives in charity to all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no gurmukh aap bujhaae so sadh hee dharageh paae maan ||
verses.translation: One whom He has enlightened and made Gurmukh, ever obtains honor in His Court.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jis dhee paij rakhai har suaamee so sachaa har jaan ||14||
verses.translation: One whose honor the Lord Master has preserved, comes to know the True Lord. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bin satigur bheTe jag a(n)dh hai a(n)dhe karam kamai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without meeting the True Guru, the world is blind, and it does blind deeds.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਵਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai siau chit na laaviee jit sukh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: It does not focus its consciousness on the Word of the Shabad, which would bring peace to abide in the mind.

verses.original: ਤਾਮਸਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਲਤੁ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: taamas lagaa sadhaa firai ahinis jalat bihai ||
verses.translation: Always afflicted with the dark passions of low energy, it wanders around, passing its days and nights burning.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; no one has any say in this. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo furamaiaa kaaree eh kareh ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has commanded us to do this:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: guroo dhuaarai hoi kai saahib sa(n)maaleh ||
verses.translation: through the Guru's Gate, meditate on the Lord Master.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਕੇ ਛਉੜ ਕਟਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahib sadhaa hajoor hai bharamai ke chhauR kaT kai a(n)tar jot dhareh ||
verses.translation: The Lord Master is ever-present. He tears away the veil of doubt, and installs His Light within the mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਏਹੁ ਲਾਏਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam a(n)mrit hai dhaaroo eh laaeh ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar - take this healing medicine!

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit rakhahu sa(n)jam sachaa neh ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Will of the True Guru in your consciousness, and make the True Lord's Love your self-discipline.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aaithai sukhai a(n)dhar rakhasee agai har siau kel kareh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, you shall be kept in peace here, and hereafter, you shall celebrate with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਬਣਸਪਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhaar aThaareh banasapat aape hee fal laae ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the vast variety of Nature, and He Himself makes it bear fruit.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਲੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਸਿੰਚੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape maalee aap sabh si(n)chai aape hee muh paae ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Gardener, He Himself irrigates all the plants, and He Himself puts them in His mouth.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa aape bhugataa aape dhei dhivaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself gives, and causes others to give.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape saahib aape hai raakhaa aape rahiaa samaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the Protector; He Himself is permeating and pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak vaddiaaiee aakhai har karate kee jis no til na tamaae ||15||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak speaks of the greatness of the Lord, the Creator, who has no greed at all. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਆਣਿਆ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: maanas bhariaa aaniaa maanas bhariaa aai ||
verses.translation: One person brings a full bottle, and another fills his cup.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਰਲੁ ਪਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jit peetai mat dhoor hoi baral pavai vich aai ||
verses.translation: Drinking the wine, his intelligence departs, and madness enters his mind;

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa paraiaa na pachhaaniee khasamahu dhake khai ||
verses.translation: he cannot distinguish between his own and others, and he is struck down by his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jit peetai khasam visarai dharageh milai sajai ||
verses.translation: Drinking it, he forgets his Lord and Master, and he is punished in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪੀਚਈ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa madh mool na peechiee je kaa paar vasai ||
verses.translation: Do not drink the false wine at all, if it is in your power.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee sach madh paieeaai satigur milai jis aai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets the mortal; by His Grace, one obtains the True Wine.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa saahib kai ra(n)g rahai mahalee paavai thaau ||1||
verses.translation: He shall dwell forever in the Love of the Lord Master, and obtain a seat in the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਜਾ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih jagat jeevat marai jaa is no sojhee hoi ||
verses.translation: When this world comes to understand, it remains dead while yet alive.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਨਿੑ ਸਵਾਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਸਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tini(h) savaaliaa taa(n) sav rahiaa jagaae taa(n) sudh hoi ||
verses.translation: When the Lord puts him to sleep, he remains asleep; when He wakes him up, he regains consciousness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak nadhar kare je aapanee satigur melai soi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He causes him to meet the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh jeevat marai taa fir maran na hoi ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, remain dead while yet alive, and you shall not have to die again. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa keetaa sabh kichh hovai tis no paravaeh naahee kisai keree ||
verses.translation: By His doing, everything happens; what does He care for anyone else?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਖਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਕਢੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau teraa dhitaa sabh ko khaavai sabh muhataajee kaddai teree ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, everyone eats whatever You give - all are subservient to You.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਤੁਧ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: j tudh no saalaahe su sabh kichh paavai jis no kirapaa nira(n)jan keree ||
verses.translation: One who praises You obtains everything; You bestow Your Mercy upon him, O Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: soiee saahu sachaa vanajaaraa jin vakhar ladhiaa har naam dhan teree ||
verses.translation: He alone is a true banker and trader, who loads the merchandise of the wealth of the Your Name, O Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਵ ਕੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: sabh tisai no saalaahih sa(n)tahu jin dhooje bhaav kee maar viddaaree dderee ||16||
verses.translation: O Saints, let everyone praise the Lord, who has destroyed the pile of the love of duality. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਰਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeeraa marataa marataa jag muaa mar bh na jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, the world is dying - dying to death, but no one knows how to truly die.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਮਰਨੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaisee maranee jo marai bahur na maranaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever dies, let him die such a death, that he does not have to die again. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਵ ਮਰਹਗੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jaanaa kiv marahage kaisaa maranaa hoi ||
verses.translation: What do I know? How will I die? What sort of death will it be?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: je kar saahib manahu na veesarai taa sahilaa maranaa hoi ||
verses.translation: If I do not forget the Lord Master from my mind, then my death will be easy.

verses.original: ਮਰਣੈ ਤੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਡਰੈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਲੋੜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maranai te jagat ddarai jeeviaa loRai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: The world is terrified of death; everyone longs to live.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jeevat marai hukamai boojhai soi ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one who dies while yet alive, understands the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸੀ ਮਰਨੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aaisee maranee jo marai taa sadh jeevan hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who dies such a death, lives forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਆਪਣਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa aap kirapaal hovai har suaamee taa aapanaa(n) naau har aap japaavai ||
verses.translation: When the Lord Master Himself becomes merciful, the Lord Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਣਾਂ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape satigur mel sukh dhevai aapanaa(n) sevak aap har bhaavai ||
verses.translation: He Himself causes us to meet the True Guru, and blesses us with peace. His servant is pleasing to the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aapaniaa sevakaa kee aap paij rakhai aapaniaa bhagataa kee pairee paavai ||
verses.translation: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He causes others to fall at the feet of His devotees.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai hai har kaa keeaa har jan sevak neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is a creation of the Lord; he does not approach the humble servant of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jo har kaa piaaraa so sabhanaa kaa piaaraa hor ketee jhakh jhakh aavai jaavai ||17||
verses.translation: One who is dear to the Lord, is dear to all; so many others come and go in vain. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam raam karataa sabh jag firai raam na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The entire world roams around, chanting, ""Raam, Raam, Lord, Lord"", but the Lord cannot be obtained like this.

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar at vaddaa atul na tuliaa jai ||
verses.translation: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and so very great; He is unweighable, and cannot be weighed.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kinai na paieeaa kitai na liaa jai ||
verses.translation: No one can evaluate Him; He cannot be purchased at any price.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh bhedhiaa in bidh vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His mystery is known; in this way, He comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੇਉ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aap ameau hai gur kirapaa te rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself is infinite; by Guru's Grace, He is known to be permeating and pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape miliaa mil rahiaa aape miliaa aai ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself comes to blend, and having blended, remains blended. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: e man ih dhan naam hai jit sadhaa sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: O my soul, this is the wealth of the Naam; through it, comes peace, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: toTaa mool na aaviee laahaa sadh hee hoi ||
verses.translation: It never brings any loss; through it, one earns profits forever.

verses.original: ਖਾਧੈ ਖਰਚਿਐ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: khaadhai kharachiaai toT na aaviee sadhaa sadhaa oh dhei ||
verses.translation: Eating and spending it, it never decreases; He continues to give, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਾਣਤ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahasaa mool na hoviee haanat kadhe na hoi ||
verses.translation: One who has no skepticism at all never suffers humiliation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh paieeaai jaa kau nadhar karei ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the Name of the Lord, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape sabh ghaT a(n)dhare aape hee baahar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is deep within all hearts, and He Himself is outside them.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape gupat varatadhaa aape hee jaahar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is prevailing unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸੁੰਨਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jug chhateeh gubaar kar varatiaa su(n)naahar ||
verses.translation: For thirty-six ages, He created the darkness, abiding in the void.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਨ ਸਾਸਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: othai vedh puraan na saasataa aape har narahar ||
verses.translation: There were no Vedas, Puraanas or Shaastras there; only the Lord Himself existed.

verses.original: ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: baiThaa taaRee lai aap sabh dhoo hee baahar ||
verses.translation: He Himself sat in the absolute trance, withdrawn from everything.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗਉਹਰੁ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: aapanee mit aap jaanadhaa aape hee gauhar ||18||
verses.translation: Only He Himself knows His state; He Himself is the unfathomable ocean. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਰਦੋ ਮਰਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich jagat muaa maradho maradhaa jai ||
verses.translation: In egotism, the world is dead; it dies and dies, again and again.

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jichar vich dha(n)m hai tichar na chetiee k kareg agai jai ||
verses.translation: As long as there is breath in the body, he does not remember the Lord; what will he do in the world hereafter?

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਚੇਤੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee hoi su cheta(n)n hoi agiaanee a(n)dh kamai ||
verses.translation: One who remembers the Lord is a spiritual teacher; the ignorant one acts blindly.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ethai kamaavai so milai agai paae jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever one does in this world, determines what he shall receive in the world hereafter. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhur khasamai kaa hukam piaa vin satigur chetiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: From the very beginning, it has been the Will of the Lord Master, that He cannot be remembered without the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai a(n)tar rav rahiaa sadhaa rahiaa liv lai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, he realizes that the Lord is permeating and pervading deep within him; he remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਦਮਿ ਦਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਦਾ ਦੰਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dham dham sadhaa samaaladhaa dha(n)m na birathaa jai ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, he constantly remembers the Lord in meditation; not a single breath passes in vain.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kaa bhau giaa jeevan padhavee pai ||
verses.translation: His fears of birth and death depart, and he obtains the honored state of eternal life.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਰਤਬਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ih maratabaa tis no dhei jis no kirapaa kare rajai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He bestows this rank upon that mortal, upon whom He showers His Mercy. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਬੀਨਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhaanaa(n) beeniaa aape paradhaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: He Himself is all-wise and all-knowing; He Himself is supreme.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਲਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aape roop dhikhaaladhaa aape lai dhiaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: He Himself reveals His form, and He Himself enjoins us to His meditation.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਨੀ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੈ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aape monee varatadhaa aape kathai giaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: He Himself poses as a silent sage, and He Himself speaks spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਕਉੜਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੀ ਭਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kauRaa kisai na lagiee sabhanaa hee bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: He does not seem bitter to anyone; He is pleasing to all.

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: ausatat baran na sakeeaai sadh sadh kurabaanaa ||19||
verses.translation: His Praises cannot be described; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿੰਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kalee a(n)dhar naanakaa ji(n)naa(n) dhaa aautaar ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, the demons have taken birth.

verses.original: ਪੁਤੁ ਜਿਨੂਰਾ ਧੀਅ ਜਿੰਨੂਰੀ ਜੋਰੂ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: put jinooraa dheea ji(n)nooree joroo ji(n)naa dhaa sikadhaar ||1||
verses.translation: The son is a demon, and the daughter is a demon; the wife is the chief of the demons. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਲੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਅਖੁਟੀ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: hi(n)dhoo moole bhoole akhuTee jaa(n)hee ||
verses.translation: The Hindus have forgotten the Primal Lord; they are going the wrong way.

verses.original: ਨਾਰਦਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਂਹੀ ॥ ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naaradh kahiaa s pooj karaa(n)hee || a(n)dhe gu(n)ge a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: As Naarad instructed them, they are worshipping idols. They are blind and mute, the blindest of the blind.

verses.original: ਪਾਥਰੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: paathar le poojeh mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: The ignorant fools pick up stones and worship them.

verses.original: ਓਹਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਾ ਤਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: oh jaa aap ddube tum kahaa taranahaar ||2||
verses.translation: But when those stones themselves sink, who will carry you across? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kih terai vas hai too sachaa saahu ||
verses.translation: Everything is in Your power; You are the True King.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat rate ra(n)g ek kai pooraa vesaahu ||
verses.translation: The devotees are imbued with the Love of the One Lord; they have perfect faith in Him.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਜਨ ਖਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit bhojan naam har raj raj jan khaahu ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the ambrosial food; His humble servants eat their fill.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh padhaarath paieean simaran sach laahu ||
verses.translation: All treasures are obtained - meditative remembrance on the Lord is the true profit.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t piaare paarabraham naanak har agam agaahu ||20||
verses.translation: The Saints are very dear to the Supreme Lord God, O Nanak; the Lord is unapproachable and unfathomable. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh hukame aavadhaa sabh kichh hukame jai ||
verses.translation: Everything comes by the Lord's Will, and everything goes by the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je ko moorakh aapahu jaanai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamai ||
verses.translation: If some fool believes that he is the creator, he is blind, and acts in blindness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam ko gurmukh bujhai jis no kirapaa kare rajai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the Lord showers His Mercy upon him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: so jogee jugat so paae jis no gurmukh naam paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Yogi, and he alone finds the Way, who, as Gurmukh, obtains the Naam.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਖੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis jogee kee nagaree sabh ko vasai bhekhee jog na hoi ||
verses.translation: In the body-village of that Yogi are all blessings; this Yoga is not obtained by outward show.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aaisaa viralaa ko jogee jis ghaT paragaT hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, such a Yogi is very rare; the Lord is manifest in his heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape ja(n)t upaian aape aadhaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the creatures, and He Himself supports them.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sookham bhaaleeaai aape paasaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is seen to be subtle, and He Himself is obvious.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਇਕਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap ikaatee hoi rahai aape vadd paravaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself remains a solitary recluse, and He Himself has a huge family.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਰੇਨਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)gai dhaan har sa(n)taa renaar ||
verses.translation: Nanak asks for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: hor dhaataar na sujhiee too dhevanahaar ||21||1|| sudh ||
verses.translation: I cannot see any other Giver; You alone are the Giver, O Lord. ||21||1|| Sudh||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Wadahans, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਮਛੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: amalee amal na a(n)baRai machhee neer na hoi ||
verses.translation: To the addict, there is nothing like the drug; to the fish, there is nothing else like water.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo rate seh aapanai tin bhaavai sabh koi ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to their Lord - everyone is pleasing to them. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਤਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree va(n)n(j)aa kha(n)neeaai va(n)n(j)aa tau saahib ke naavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, cut apart into pieces, a sacrifice to Your Name, O Lord Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਰੁਖੜਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saahib safalio rukhaRaa a(n)mrit jaa kaa naau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the fruitful tree; His Name is ambrosial nectar.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਭਏ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin peeaa te tirapat bhe hau tin balihaarai jaau ||2||
verses.translation: Those who drink it in are satisfied; I am a sacrifice to them. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਭੀਆਂ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: mai kee nadhar na aavahee vaseh habheeaa(n) naal ||
verses.translation: You are not visible to me, although You dwell with everyone.

verses.original: ਤਿਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tikhaa tihaiaa kiau lahai jaa sar bheetar paal ||3||
verses.translation: How can the thirst of the thirsty be quenched, with that wall between me and the pond? ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak teraa baaneeaa too saahib mai raas ||
verses.translation: Nanak is Your merchant; You, O Lord Master, are my merchandise.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੋਖਾ ਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: man te dhokhaa taa lahai jaa sifat karee aradhaas ||4||1||
verses.translation: My mind is cleansed of doubt, only when I praise You, and pray to You. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee sahu raaviaa niragun kooke kai ||
verses.translation: The virtuous bride enjoys her Husband Lord; why does the unworthy one cry out?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਥੀ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: je gunava(n)tee thee rahai taa bhee sahu raavan jai ||1||
verses.translation: If she were to become virtuous, then she too could enjoy her Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਕੀ ਧਨ ਅਵਰਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa ka(n)t reesaaloo kee dhan avaraa raave jee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord is loving and playful; why should the soul-bride enjoy anyone else? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਗਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: karanee kaaman je theeaai je man dhaagaa hoi ||
verses.translation: If the soul-bride does good deeds, and strings them on the thread of her mind,

verses.original: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਜੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maanak mul na paieeaai leejai chit paroi ||2||
verses.translation: she obtains the jewel, which cannot be purchased for any price, strung upon the thread of her consciousness. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਹੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨ ਜੁਲਾਂ ਆਖਾਂ ਅੰਮੜੀਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: raahu dhasaiee na julaa(n) aakhaa(n) a(n)maReeaas ||
verses.translation: I ask, but do not follow the way shown to me; still, I claim to have reached my destination.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਅਕੂਅਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਵੈ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tai seh naal akooanaa kiau theevai ghar vaas ||3||
verses.translation: I do not speak with You, O my Husband Lord; how then can I come to have a place in Your home? ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ekee baaharaa dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the One Lord, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਲਗੀ ਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: tai seh lagee je rahai bhee sahu raavai soi ||4||2||
verses.translation: If the soul-bride remains attached to You, then she shall enjoy her Husband Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਮੋਰੀ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣ ਲਾਇਆ ਭੈਣੇ ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moree run jhun laiaa bhaine saavan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The peacocks are singing so sweetly, O sister; the rainy season of Saawan has come.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਮੁੰਧ ਕਟਾਰੇ ਜੇਵਡਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tere mu(n)dh kaTaare jevaddaa tin lobhee lobh lubhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Your beauteous eyes are like a string of charms, fascinating and enticing the soul-bride.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: tere dharasan viTahu kha(n)neeaai va(n)n(j)aa tere naam viTahu kurabaano ||
verses.translation: I would cut myself into pieces for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too taa mai maan keeaa hai tudh bin kehaa meraa maano ||
verses.translation: I take pride in You; without You, what could I be proud of?

verses.original: ਚੂੜਾ ਭੰਨੁ ਪਲੰਘ ਸਿਉ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸਣੁ ਬਾਹੀ ਸਣੁ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: chooRaa bha(n)n pala(n)gh siau mu(n)dhe san baahee san baahaa ||
verses.translation: So smash your bracelets along with your bed, O soul-bride, and break your arms, along with the arms of your couch.

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀਏ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤੋ ਅਵਰਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: ete ves karedhe'ee mu(n)dhe sahu raato avaraahaa ||
verses.translation: In spite of all the decorations which you have made, O soul-bride, your Husband Lord is enjoying someone else.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮਨੀਆਰੁ ਨ ਚੂੜੀਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਗੁੜੀਆਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa maneeaar na chooReeaa naa se va(n)guReeaahaa ||
verses.translation: You don't have the bracelets of gold, nor the good crystal jewelry; you haven't dealt with the true jeweller.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਕੰਠਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਜਲਨੁ ਸਿ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo seh ka(n)Th na lageeaa jalan s baahaReeaahaa ||
verses.translation: Those arms, which do not embrace the neck of the Husband Lord, burn in anguish.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਗਈਆ ਹਉ ਦਾਧੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh saheeaa sahu raavan gieeaa hau dhaadhee kai dhar jaavaa ||
verses.translation: All my companions have gone to enjoy their Husband Lord; which door should I, the wretched one, go to?

verses.original: ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਚਜੀ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਏਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)maalee hau kharee suchajee tai seh ek na bhaavaa ||
verses.translation: O friend, I may look very attractive, but I am not pleasing to my Husband Lord at all.

verses.original: ਮਾਠਿ ਗੁੰਦਾੲਂੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਭਰੀਐ ਮਾਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maaTh gu(n)dhaae(n)ee paTeeaa bhareeaai maag sa(n)dhoore ||
verses.translation: I have woven my hair into lovely braids, and saturated their partings with vermillion;

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਗਈ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਆ ਮਰਉ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: agai giee na ma(n)neeaa marau visoor visoore ||
verses.translation: but when I go before Him, I am not accepted, and I die, suffering in anguish.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਰੋਵੰਦੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਰੁਨਾ ਰੁੰਨੜੇ ਵਣਹੁ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ॥
verses.translit: mai rova(n)dhee sabh jag runaa ru(n)naRe vanahu pa(n)kheroo ||
verses.translation: I weep; the whole world weeps; even the birds of the forest weep with me.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਨ ਰੁਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik na runaa mere tan kaa birahaa jin hau pirahu vichhoRee ||
verses.translation: The only thing which doesn't weep is my body's sense of separateness, which has separated me from my Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਆਇਆ ਭੀ ਗਇਆ ਮੈ ਜਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: supanai aaiaa bhee giaa mai jal bhariaa roi ||
verses.translation: In a dream, He came, and went away again; I cried so many tears.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭੇਜਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aai na sakaa tujh kan piaare bhej na sakaa koi ||
verses.translation: I can't come to You, O my Beloved, and I can't send anyone to You.

verses.original: ਆਉ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਨੀਦੜੀਏ ਮਤੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aau sabhaagee needhaRe'e mat sahu dhekhaa soi ||
verses.translation: Come to me, O blessed sleep - perhaps I will see my Husband Lord again.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਜਿ ਆਖੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: tai saahib kee baat j aakhai kahu naanak kiaa dheejai ||
verses.translation: One who brings me a message from my Lord and Master - says Nanak, what shall I give to Him?

verses.original: ਸੀਸੁ ਵਢੇ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sees vadde kar baisan dheejai vin sir sev kareejai ||
verses.translation: Cutting off my head, I give it to Him to sit upon; without my head, I shall still serve Him.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: kiau na mareejai jeeaRaa na dheejai jaa sahu bhiaa viddaanaa ||1||3||
verses.translation: Why haven't I died? Why hasn't my life just ended? My Husband Lord has become a stranger to me. ||1||3||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨਿ ਧੋਤੈ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mailai sabh kichh mailaa tan dhotai man hachhaa na hoi ||
verses.translation: When the mind is filthy, everything is filthy; by washing the body, the mind is not cleaned.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eeh jagat bharam bhulaiaa viralaa boojhai koi ||1||
verses.translation: This world is deluded by doubt; how rare are those who understand this. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap man mere too eko naam ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the One Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dheeaa mo kau eh nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has given me this treasure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਧਾ ਕੇ ਆਸਣ ਜੇ ਸਿਖੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
