verses.translit: sidhaa ke aasan je sikhai i(n)dhree vas kar kamai ||
verses.translation: Even if one learns the Yogic postures of the Siddhas, and holds his sexual energy in check,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man kee mail na utarai haumai mail na jai ||2||
verses.translation: still, the filth of the mind is not removed, and the filth of egotism is not eliminated. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis man kau hor sa(n)jam ko naahee vin satigur kee saranai ||
verses.translation: This mind is not controlled by any other discipline, except the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satagur miliaai ulaTee bhiee kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one is transformed beyond description. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਦੋ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak satigur kau miladho marai gur kai sabadh fir jeevai koi ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, one who dies upon meeting the True Guru, shall be rejuvenated through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: mamataa kee mal utarai ih man hachhaa hoi ||4||1||
verses.translation: The filth of his attachment and possessiveness shall depart, and his mind shall become pure. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee satagur seveeaai nadharee sevaa hoi ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, one serves the True Guru; by His Grace, service is performed.

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nadharee ih man vas aavai nadharee man niramal hoi ||1||
verses.translation: By His grace, this mind is controlled, and by His Grace, it becomes pure. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man chet sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, think of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eko cheteh taa sukh paaveh fir dhookh na moole hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Think of the One Lord, and you shall obtain peace; you shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਮਰਿ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee mar kai jeeveeaai nadharee sabadh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, one dies while yet alive, and by His Grace, the Word of the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nadharee hukam bujheeaai hukame rahai samai ||2||
verses.translation: By His Grace, one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and by His Command, one merges into the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਸਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin jihavaa har ras na chakhio saa jihavaa jal jaau ||
verses.translation: That tongue, which does not savor the sublime essence of the Lord - may that tongue be burned off!

verses.original: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: an ras saadhe lag rahee dhukh paiaa dhoojai bhai ||3||
verses.translation: It remains attached to other pleasures, and through the love of duality, it suffers in pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa nadhar ek hai aape farak karei ||
verses.translation: The One Lord grants His Grace to all; He Himself makes distinctions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak satagur miliaai fal paiaa naam vaddaiee dhei ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, the fruits are obtained, and one is blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh gubaar hai gur bin giaan na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is darkness; without the Guru, there is no wisdom.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabadh lage tin bujhiaa dhoojai paraj vigoiee ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to the Word of the Shabad understand; duality has ruined the people. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere gurmat karanee saar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, under Guru's Instruction, do good deeds.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa har prabh raveh taa paaveh mokh dhuaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dwell forever and ever upon the Lord God, and you shall find the gate of salvation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gunaa kaa nidhaan ek hai aape dhei taa ko paae ||
verses.translation: The Lord alone is the treasure of virtue; He Himself gives, and then one receives.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sabh vichhuRee gur kai sabadh milaae ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Name, all are separated from the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਘਟਿ ਗਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਥਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree karadhe ghaT ge tinaa hath kih na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Acting in ego, they lose, and nothing comes into their hands.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satagur miliaai sach mile sach naam samaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, they find Truth, and merge into the True Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa eh sareer hai a(n)tar jot jagaae ||
verses.translation: Hope and desire abide in this body, but the Lord's Light shines within as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak manmukh ba(n)dh hai gurmukh mukat karaae ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs remain in bondage; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sohaaganee sadhaa mukh ujalaa gur kai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: The faces of the happy soul-brides are radiant forever; through the Guru, they are peacefully poised.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa pir raaveh aapanaa vichahu aap gavai ||1||
verses.translation: They enjoy their Husband Lord constantly, eradicating their ego from within. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man too har har naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satagur mo kau har dheeaa bujhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has led me to understand the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਖਰੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhohaaganee khareeaa bilalaadheeaa tinaa mahal na pai ||
verses.translation: The abandoned brides cry out in their suffering; they do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੂਪੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai karoopee dhookh paaveh aagai jai ||2||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, they appear so ugly; they suffer in pain as they go to the world beyond. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee nit gun ravai hiradhai naam vasai ||
verses.translation: The virtuous soul-bride constantly chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord; she enshrines the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within her heart.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aauganava(n)tee kaamanee dhukh laagai bilalai ||3||
verses.translation: The unvirtuous woman suffers, and cries out in pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa bhataar ek hai suaamee kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: The One Lord and Master is the Husband Lord of all; His Praises cannot be expressed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਕ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak aape vek keetian naame lian lai ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He has separated some from Himself, while others are to His Name. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam sadh meeThaa laagaa gur sabadhee saadh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is always sweet to me; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I come to taste it.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee sahaj samaanee har jeeau man vasaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, I am merged in peace and poise; the Dear Lord is enshrined in the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har kar kirapaa sataguroo milaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, showing His Mercy, has caused me to meet the True Guru.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poorai satagur har naam dhiaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect True Guru, I meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: brahamai bedh baanee paragaasee maiaa moh pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through Brahma, the hymns of the Vedas were revealed, but the love of Maya spread.

verses.original: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mahaadheau giaanee varatai ghar aapanai taamas bahut aha(n)kaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The wise one, Shiva, remains absorbed in himself, but he is engrossed in dark passions and excessive egotism. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਰੂਧਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kisan sadhaa avataaree roodhaa kit lag tarai sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Vishnu is always busy reincarnating himself - who will save the world?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaan rate jug a(n)tar chookai moh gubaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are imbued with spiritual wisdom in this age; they are rid of the darkness of emotional attachment. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: satagur sevaa te nisataaraa gurmukh tarai sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, one is emancipated; the Gurmukh crosses over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saachai nai rate bairaagee pain mokh dhuaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: The detached renunciates are imbued with the True Name; they attain the gate of salvation. ||4||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: eko sach varatai sabh a(n)tar sabhanaa kare pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: The One True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; He cherishes everyone.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੀਵਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੫॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak ikas bin mai avar na jaanaa sabhanaa dheevaan dhiaalaa ||5||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the One Lord, I do not know any other; He is the Merciful Master of all. ||5||5||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sach sa(n)jam tat giaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh practices true self-discipline, and attains the essence of wisdom.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saache lagai dhiaan ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh man mere naam samaal ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, O my mind, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa nibahai chalai terai naal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: It shall stand by you always, and go with you. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaat pat sach soi ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is the social status and honor of the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)tar sakhaiee prabh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Within the Gurmukh, is God, his friend and helper. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jis no aap kare so hoi ||
verses.translation: He alone becomes Gurmukh, whom the Lord so blesses.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aap vaddaiee dhevai soi ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with greatness. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadh sach karanee saar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh lives the True Word of the Shabad, and practices good deeds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naanak paravaarai saadhaar ||4||6||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, emancipates his family and relations. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦਿ ਲਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa har saadh lagee sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: My tongue is intuitively attracted to the taste of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man tirapatiaa har naam dhiaai ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is satisfied, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sukh saachai sabadh veechaaree ||
verses.translation: Lasting peace is obtained, contemplating the Shabad, the True Word of God.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapane satagur viTahu sadhaa balihaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: akhee sa(n)tokheeaa ek liv lai ||
verses.translation: My eyes are content, lovingly focused on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man sa(n)tokhiaa dhoojaa bhaau gavai ||2||
verses.translation: My mind is content, having forsaken the love of duality. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dheh sareer sukh hovai sabadh har nai ||
verses.translation: The frame of my body is at peace, through the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam paramal hiradhai rahiaa samai ||3||
verses.translation: The fragrance of the Naam permeates my heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak masatak jis vaddabhaag ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who has such great destiny written upon his forehead,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee sahaj bairaag ||4||7||
verses.translation: through the Bani of the Guru's Word, easily and intuitively becomes free of desire. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te naam paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: From the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh sach samai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the True Word of God, one merges in the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e man naam nidhaan too pai ||
verses.translation: O my soul, obtain the treasure of the Naam,

verses.original: ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapane gur kee ma(n)n lai rajai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: by submitting to the Will of your Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh vichahu mail gavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, filth is washed away from within.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: niramal naam vasai man aai ||2||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Naam comes to abide within the mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bharame bhoolaa firai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, the world wanders around.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mar janamai jam kare khuaar ||3||
verses.translation: It dies, and is born again, and is ruined by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak se vaddabhaagee jin har naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ma(n)n vasaiaa ||4||8||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Name within their minds. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai naavai naal virodh hai dhui na vaseh ik Thai ||
verses.translation: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haumai vich sevaa na hoviee taa man birathaa jai ||1||
verses.translation: In egotism, selfless service cannot be performed, and so the soul goes unfulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har chet man mere too gur kaa sabadh kamai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, think of the Lord, and practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hukam ma(n)neh taa har milai taa vichahu haumai jai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you submit to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then you shall meet with the Lord; only then will your ego depart from within. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai sabh sareer hai haumai opat hoi ||
verses.translation: Egotism is within all bodies; through egotism, we come to be born.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: haumai vaddaa gubaar hai haumai vich bujh na sakai koi ||2||
verses.translation: Egotism is total darkness; in egotism, no one can understand anything. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich bhagat na hoviee hukam na bujhiaa jai ||
verses.translation: In egotism, devotional worship cannot be performed, and the Hukam of the Lord's Command cannot be understood.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai vich jeeau ba(n)dh hai naam na vasai man aai ||3||
verses.translation: In egotism, the soul is in bondage, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to abide in the mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak satagur miliaai haumai giee taa sach vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, egotism is eliminated, and then, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sach kamaavai sach rahai sache sev samai ||4||9||12||
verses.translation: One starts practicing truth, abides in truth and by serving the True One gets absorbed in Him. ||4||9||12||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sej ek eko prabh Thaakur ||
verses.translation: There is one bed, and One Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har raave sukh saagar ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh enjoys the Lord, the ocean of peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai prabh milan prem man aasaa ||
verses.translation: My mind longs to meet my Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa melaavai meraa preetam hau vaar vaar aapane guroo kau jaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru leads me to meet my Beloved; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai avagan bharapoor sareere ||
verses.translation: My body is over-flowing with corruption;

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਾ ਅਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau kiau kar milaa apane preetam poore ||2||
verses.translation: how can I meet my Perfect Beloved? ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin gunava(n)tee meraa preetam paiaa ||
verses.translation: The virtuous ones obtain my Beloved;

verses.original: ਸੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se mai gun naahee hau kiau milaa meree maiaa ||3||
verses.translation: I do not have these virtues. How can I meet Him, O my mother? ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਉਪਾਵ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau kar kar thaakaa upaav bahutere ||
verses.translation: I am so tired of making all these efforts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰੀਬ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gareeb raakhahu har mere ||4||1||
verses.translation: Please protect Nanak, the meek one, O my Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: meraa har prabh su(n)dhar mai saar na jaanee ||
verses.translation: My Lord God is so beautiful. I do not know His worth.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hau har prabh chhodd dhoojai lobhaanee ||1||
verses.translation: Abandoning my Lord God, I have become entangled in duality. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਉ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: hau kiau kar pir kau milau iaanee ||
verses.translation: How can I meet with my Husband? I don't know.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਪਿਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo pir bhaavai saa sohaagan saiee pir kau milai siaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: She who pleases her Husband Lord is a happy soul-bride. She meets with her Husband Lord - she is so wise. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੋਸ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai vich dhos hau kiau kar pir paavaa ||
verses.translation: I am filled with faults; how can I attain my Husband Lord?

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਪਿਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tere anek piaare hau pir chit na aavaa ||2||
verses.translation: You have many loves, but I am not in Your thoughts, O my Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin pir raaviaa saa bhalee suhaagan ||
verses.translation: She who enjoys her Husband Lord, is the good soul-bride.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਣਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se mai gun naahee hau kiaa karee dhuhaagan ||3||
verses.translation: I don't have these virtues; what can I, the discarded bride, do? ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nit suhaagan sadhaa pir raavai ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride continually, constantly enjoys her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mai karamaheen kab hee gal laavai ||4||
verses.translation: I have no good fortune; will He ever hold me close in His embrace? ||4||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਉ ਅਉਗੁਣਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too pir gunava(n)taa hau aauguniaaraa ||
verses.translation: You, O Husband Lord, are meritorious, while I am without merit.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai niragun bakhas naanak vechaaraa ||5||2||
verses.translation: I am worthless; please forgive Nanak, the meek. ||5||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਡੀ ਆਸ ਹਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai man vaddee aas hare kiau kar har dharasan paavaa ||
verses.translation: Within my mind there is such a great yearning; how will I attain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?

verses.original: ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਤਗੁਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau jai puchhaa apane satagurai gur puchh man mugadh samajhaavaa ||
verses.translation: I go and ask my True Guru; with the Guru's advice, I shall teach my foolish mind.

verses.original: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolaa man samajhai gur sabadhee har har sadhaa dhiaae ||
verses.translation: The foolish mind is instructed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and meditates forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis nadhar kare meraa piaaraa so har charanee chit laae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Mercy of my Beloved, focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸਭਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau sabh ves karee pir kaaran je har prabh saache bhaavaa ||
verses.translation: I dress myself in all sorts of robes for my Husband, so that my True Lord God will be pleased.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: so pir piaaraa mai nadhar na dhekhai hau kiau kar dheeraj paavaa ||
verses.translation: But my Beloved Husband Lord does not even cast a glance in my direction; how can I be consoled?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਹਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਵਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaaran hau seegaar seegaaree so pir rataa meraa avaraa ||
verses.translation: For His sake, I adorn myself with adornments, but my Husband is imbued with the love of another.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਅੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhan dha(n)n dha(n)n sohaagan jin pir raaviaRaa sach savaraa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed is that soul-bride, who enjoys her True, Sublime Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਸੋਹਾਗ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਤੁਸੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau jai puchhaa sohaag suhaagan tusee kiau pir paiaRaa prabh meraa ||
verses.translation: I go and ask the fortunate, happy soul-bride, ""How did you attain Him - your Husband Lord, my God?""

verses.original: ਮੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਛੋਡਿਅੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai uoopar nadhar karee pir saachai mai chhoddiaRaa meraa teraa ||
verses.translation: She answers, ""My True Husband blessed me with His Mercy; I abandoned the distinction between mine and yours.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਭੈਣੇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabh man tan jeeau karahu har prabh kaa it maarag bhaine mileeaai ||
verses.translation: Dedicate everything, mind, body and soul, to the Lord God; this is the Path to meet Him, O sister.""

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਰਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aapanaRaa prabh nadhar kar dhekhai naanak jot jotee raleeaai ||3||
verses.translation: If her God gazes upon her with favor, O Nanak, her light merges into the Light. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo har prabh kaa mai dhei sanehaa tis man tan apanaa dhevaa ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind and body to the one who brings me a message from my Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: nit pakhaa feree sev kamaavaa tis aagai paanee ddovaa(n) ||
verses.translation: I wave the fan over him every day, serve him and carry water for him.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit sev karee har jan kee jo har har kathaa sunaae ||
verses.translation: Constantly and continuously, I serve the Lord's humble servant, who recites to me the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n guroo gur satigur pooraa naanak man aas pujaae ||4||
verses.translation: Hail, hail unto the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, who fulfills Nanak's heart's desires. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur sajan meraa mel hare jit mil har naam dhiaavaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, let me meet the Guru, my best friend; meeting Him, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਪੂਛਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur paasahu har gosaT poochhaa(n) kar saa(n)jhee har gun gaavaa(n) ||
verses.translation: I seek the Lord's sermon from the Guru, the True Guru; joining with Him, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavaa nit nit sadh har ke man jeevai naam sun teraa ||
verses.translation: Each and every day, forever, I sing the Lord's Praises; my mind lives by hearing Your Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jit velaa visarai meraa suaamee tit velai mar jai jeeau meraa ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that moment when I forget my Lord and Master - at that moment, my soul dies. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੋਚੈ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: har vekhan kau sabh koiee lochai so vekhai jis aap vikhaale ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs to see the Lord, but he alone sees Him, whom the Lord causes to see Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare meraa piaaraa so har har sadhaa samaale ||
verses.translation: One upon whom my Beloved bestows His Glance of Grace, cherishes the Lord, Har, Har forever.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: so har har naam sadhaa sadhaa samaale jis satagur pooraa meraa miliaa ||
verses.translation: He alone cherishes the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever, who meets my Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿਆ ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak har jan har ike hoe har jap har setee raliaa ||6||1||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's humble servant and the Lord become One; meditating on the Lord, he blends with the Lord. ||6||1||3||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: at uoochaa taa kaa dharabaaraa ||
verses.translation: His Darbaar, His Court, is the most lofty and exalted.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t naahee kichh paaraavaaraa ||
verses.translation: It has no end or limitations.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: koT koT koT lakh dhaavai ||
verses.translation: Millions, millions, tens of millions seek,

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eik til taa kaa mahal na paavai ||1||
verses.translation: but they cannot find even a tiny bit of His Mansion. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: suhaavee kaunu su velaa jit prabh melaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What is that auspicious moment, when God is met? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: laakh bhagat jaa kau aaraadheh ||
verses.translation: Tens of thousands of devotees worship Him in adoration.

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਤਪੁ ਹੀ ਸਾਧਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: laakh tapeesar tap hee saadheh ||
verses.translation: Tens of thousands of ascetics practice austere discipline.

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: laakh jogeesar karate jogaa ||
verses.translation: Tens of thousands of Yogis practice Yoga.

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਭੋਗੀਸਰ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laakh bhogeesar bhogeh bhogaa ||2||
verses.translation: Tens of thousands of pleasure seekers seek pleasure. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT vaseh jaaneh thoraa ||
verses.translation: He dwells in each and every heart, but only a few know this.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਣੁ ਪਰਦਾ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hai koiee saajan paradhaa toraa ||
verses.translation: Is there any friend who can rip apart the screen of separation?

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਜਤਨ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: karau jatan je hoi miharavaanaa ||
verses.translation: I can only make the effort, if the Lord is merciful to me.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ਜੀਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa kau dheiee jeeau kurabaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: I sacrifice my body and soul to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: firat firat sa(n)tan peh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: After wandering around for so long, I have finally come to the Saints;

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh bhram hamaaraa sagal miTaiaa ||
verses.translation: all of my pains and doubts have been eradicated.

verses.original: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭੂੰਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: mahal bulaiaa prabh a(n)mrit bhoo(n)chaa ||
verses.translation: God summoned me to the Mansion of His Presence, and blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of His Name.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਊਚਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh meraa uoochaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my God is lofty and exalted. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhanu su velaa jit dharasan karanaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that time, when the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is given;

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree satigur charanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ke dhaate preetam prabh mere ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of souls, O my Beloved God.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man jeevai prabh naam chitere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My soul lives by reflecting upon the Name of God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach ma(n)tr tumaaraa a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: True is Your Mantra, Ambrosial is the Bani of Your Word.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: seetal purakh dhirasaT sujaanee ||2||
verses.translation: Cooling and soothing is Your Presence, all-knowing is Your gaze. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach hukam tumaaraa takhat nivaasee ||
verses.translation: True is Your Command; You sit upon the eternal throne.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aai na jaavai meraa prabh abinaasee ||3||
verses.translation: My eternal God does not come or go. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum miharavaan dhaas ham dheenaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Merciful Master; I am Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib bharapur leenaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is totally permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: too bea(n)t ko viralaa jaanai ||
verses.translation: You are infinite - only a few know this.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh ko sabadh pachhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, some come to understand You through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sevak kee aradhaas piaare ||
verses.translation: Your servant offers this prayer, O Beloved:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap jeevaa prabh charan tumaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I live by meditating on Your Feet, God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal purakh mere prabh dhaate ||
verses.translation: O my Merciful and Almighty God, O Great Giver,

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiseh janaavahu tineh tum jaate ||2||
verses.translation: he alone knows You, whom You so bless. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa jaiee balihaaree ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eit ut dhekhau oT tumaaree ||3||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, I seek Your Protection. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun gun kichhoo na jaataa ||
verses.translation: I am without virtue; I know none of Your Glorious Virtues.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saadhoo dhekh man raataa ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, seeing the Holy Saint, my mind is imbued with You. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee so prabh pooraa ||
verses.translation: God is perfect - He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaan dhei saadhoo kee dhooraa ||1||
verses.translation: He blesses us with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Bless me with Your Grace, God, O Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teree oT pooran gopaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Protection, O Perfect Lord, Sustainer of the World. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: He is totally pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nikaT vasai naahee prabh dhoore ||2||
verses.translation: God is near at hand, not far away. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare so dhiaae ||
verses.translation: One whom He blesses with His Grace, meditates on Him.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har ke gun gaae ||3||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sagale pratipaare ||
verses.translation: He cherishes and sustains all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: saran pario naanak har dhuaare ||4||4||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: too vadd dhaataa a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh meh raviaa pooran prabh suaamee ||1||
verses.translation: God, the Perfect Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading in all. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere prabh preetam naam adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Name of my Beloved God is my only support.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau sun sun jeevaa naam tumaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I live by hearing, continually hearing Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teree saran satigur mere poore ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man niramal hoi sa(n)taa dhoore ||2||
verses.translation: My mind is purified by the dust of the Saints. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal hiradhai ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my heart.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tere dharasan kau jaiee balihaare ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa tere gun gaavaa ||
verses.translation: Show mercy unto me, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam japat sukh paavaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I obtain peace. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g har a(n)mrit peejai ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa jeeau marai na kabahoo chheejai ||1||
verses.translation: The soul does not die, nor does it ever waste away. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur pooraa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one meets the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te prabhoo dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one meditates on God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ratan javaahar har maanak laalaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the jewel, the pearl, the gem, the diamond.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: simar simar prabh bhe nihaalaa ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, I am in ecstasy. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jat kat pekhau saadhoo saranaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Sanctuary of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har gun gai niramal man karanaa ||3||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my soul becomes immaculately pure. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar meraa suaamee vooThaa ||
verses.translation: Within each and every heart, dwells my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂਠਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam paiaa prabh tooThaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, when God bestows His Mercy. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: visar naahee prabh dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Do not forget me, O God, Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teree saran pooran kirapaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh chit aaveh so thaan suhaavaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever You come to mind, that place is blessed.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit velaa visareh taa laagai haavaa ||1||
verses.translation: The moment I forget You, I am stricken with regret. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੂ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥੀ ॥
verses.translit: tere jeea too sadh hee saathee ||
verses.translation: All beings are Yours; You are their constant companion.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕਢੁ ਦੇ ਹਾਥੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar te kadd dhe haathee ||2||
verses.translation: Please, give me Your hand, and pull me up out of this world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa tum hee keeaa ||
verses.translation: Coming and going are by Your Will.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis too raakheh tis dhookh na theeaa ||3||
verses.translation: One whom You save is not afflicted by suffering. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: too eko saahib avar na hor ||
verses.translation: You are the One and only Lord and Master; there is no other.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: binau karai naanak kar jor ||4||7||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this prayer with his palms pressed together. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: too jaanaieh taa koiee jaanai ||
verses.translation: When You allow Yourself to be known, then we know You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teraa dheeaa naam vakhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: We chant Your Name, which You have given to us. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਸਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too acharaj kudharat teree bisamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are wonderful! Your creative potency is amazing! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape kaaran aape karanaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Cause of causes, You Yourself are the Creator.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hukame ja(n)man hukame maranaa ||2||
verses.translation: By Your Will, we are born, and by Your Will, we die. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam teraa man tan aadhaaree ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the Support of our mind and body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas bakhasees tumaaree ||3||8||
verses.translation: This is Your blessing to Nanak, Your slave. ||3||8||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: merai a(n)tar lochaa milan kee piaare hau kiau paiee gur poore ||
verses.translation: Deep within me, there is a longing to meet my Beloved; how can I attain my Perfect Guru?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਈਐ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: je sau khel khelaieeaai baalak reh na sakai bin kheere ||
verses.translation: Even though a baby may play hundreds of games, he cannot survive without milk.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਭੋਜਨ ਮੈ ਨੀਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: merai a(n)tar bhukh na utarai a(n)maalee je sau bhojan mai neere ||
verses.translation: The hunger within me is not satisfied, O my friend, even though I am served hundreds of dishes.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: merai man tan prem pira(n)m kaa bin dharasan kiau man dheere ||1||
verses.translation: My mind and body are filled with love for my Beloved; how can my soul find relief, without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan? ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਮੇਲਿਹੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun sajan mere preetam bhaiee mai melih mitr sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my dear friends and siblings - lead me to my True Friend, the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: oh jeea kee meree sabh bedhan jaanai nit sunaavai har keeaa baataa ||
verses.translation: He knows all the troubles of my soul; every day, he tells me stories of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau ik khin tis bin reh na sakaa jiau chaatirak jal kau bilalaataa ||
verses.translation: I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. I cry out for Him, just as the song-bird cries for the drop of water.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau kiaa gun tere saar samaalee mai niragun kau rakh letaa ||2||
verses.translation: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I sing? You save even worthless beings like me. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਭਈ ਉਡੀਣੀ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਦਿ ਨੈਣੀ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau bhiee uddeenee ka(n)t kau a(n)maalee so pir kadh nainee dhekhaa ||
verses.translation: I have become depressed, waiting for my Husband Lord, O my friend; when shall my eyes behold my Husband?

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ras bhogan visare bin pir kitai na lekhaa ||
verses.translation: I have forgotten how to enjoy all pleasures; without my Husband Lord, they are of no use at all.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਈ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਵੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih kaapaR tan na sukhaaviee kar na sakau hau vesaa ||
verses.translation: These clothes do not please my body; I cannot dress myself.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀ ਲਾਲੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jinee sakhee laal raaviaa piaaraa tin aagai ham aadhesaa ||3||
verses.translation: I bow to those friends of mine, who have enjoyed their Beloved Husband Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: mai sabh seegaar banaiaa a(n)maalee bin pir kaam na aae ||
verses.translation: I have adorned myself with all sorts of decorations, O my friend, but without my Husband Lord, they are of no use at all.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa seh baat na puchheeaa a(n)maalee taa birathaa joban sabh jaae ||
verses.translation: When my Husband does not care for me, O my friend, then my youth passes, totally useless.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan te sohaaganee a(n)maalee jin sahu rahiaa samaae ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are the happy soul-brides, O my friend, who are blended with their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: hau vaariaa tin sohaaganee a(n)maalee tin ke dhovaa sadh paae ||4||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those happy soul-brides; I wash their feet again and again. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਾ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jichar dhoojaa bharam saa a(n)maalee tichar mai jaaniaa prabh dhoore ||
verses.translation: As long as I suffered from duality and doubt, O my friend, I thought God was far away.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa miliaa pooraa satiguroo a(n)maalee taa aasaa manasaa sabh poore ||
verses.translation: But when I met the Perfect True Guru, O my friend, then all my hopes and desires were fulfilled.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai sarab sukhaa sukh paiaa a(n)maalee pir sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: I have obtained all pleasures and comforts, O my friend; my Husband Lord is all-pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਲਗਿ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੫॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har ra(n)g maaniaa a(n)maalee gur satigur kai lag paire ||5||1||9||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love, O my friend; I fall at the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||5||1||9||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee sach dhun sach sabadh veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: True is the Bani of His Word, and True is the melody; True is contemplative meditation on the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin sach salaahanaa dhan dhan vaddabhaag hamaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, I praise the True Lord. Blessed, blessed is my great good fortune. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man mere saache naam viTahu bal jaau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, let yourself be a sacrifice to the True Name.

verses.original: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasan dhaasaa hoi raheh taa paaveh sachaa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you become the slave of the Lord's slaves, you shall obtain the True Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa sachee sach ratee tan man sachaa hoi ||
verses.translation: True is the tongue which is imbued with Truth, and true are the mind and body.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin saache hor saalaahanaa jaaseh janam sabh khoi ||2||
verses.translation: By praising any other than the True Lord, one's whole life is wasted. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੀਜਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach khetee sach beejanaa saachaa vaapaaraa ||
verses.translation: Let Truth be the farm, Truth the seed, and Truth the merchandise you trade.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin laahaa sach naam dhan bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, you shall earn the profit of the Lord's Name; you shall have the treasure overflowing with the wealth of devotional worship. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sach Tek har naau ||
verses.translation: Let Truth be your food, and let Truth be your clothes; let your True Support be the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis no bakhase tis milai mahalee paae thaau ||4||
verses.translation: One who is so blessed by the Lord, obtains a seat in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaveh sache jaaveh sache fir joonee mool na paeh ||
verses.translation: In Truth we come, and in Truth we go, and then, we are not consigned to reincarnation again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dhar saachai sachiaar heh saache maeh samaeh ||5||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are hailed as True in the True Court; they merge in the True Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sachaa man sachaa sachee sifat sanai ||
verses.translation: Deep within they are True, and their minds are True; they sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sachai thaan sach saalaahanaa satigur balihaarai jaau ||6||
verses.translation: In the true place, they praise the True Lord; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach velaa moorat sach jit sache naal piaar ||
verses.translation: True is the time, and true is the moment, when one falls in love with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sach vekhanaa sach bolanaa sachaa sabh aakaar ||7||
verses.translation: Then, he sees Truth, and speaks the Truth; he realizes the True Lord pervading the entire Universe. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sachai mele taa mile aape le milai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one merges with the True Lord, when He merges with Himself.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau rakhasee aape kare rajai ||8||1||
verses.translation: As it pleases Him, He preserves us; He Himself ordains His Will. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa dheh dhis dhaavadhaa oh kaise har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: His mind wanders in the ten directions - how can he sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord?

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree viaap rahee adhikaiee kaam karodh nit sa(n)taavai ||1||
verses.translation: The sensory organs are totally engrossed in sensuality; sexual desire and anger constantly afflict him. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu sahaje gun raveejai ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! Chant His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam is jug meh dhulabh hai gurmat har ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is so difficult to obtain in this age; under Guru's Instruction, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh cheen man niramal hovai taa har ke gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Remembering the Word of the Shabad, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and then, one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmatee aapai aap pachhaanai taa nij ghar vaasaa paavai ||2||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand his own self, and then, he comes to dwell in the home of his inner self. ||2||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e man mere sadhaa ra(n)g raate sadhaa har ke gun gaau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, be imbued forever with the Lord's Love, and sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har niramal sadhaa sukhadhaataa man chi(n)dhiaa fal paau ||3||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord is forever the Giver of peace; from Him, one receives the fruits of his heart's desires. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਸੇ ਊਤਮ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham neech se uootam bhe har kee saranaiee ||
verses.translation: I am lowly, but I have been exalted, entering the Sanctuary of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਥਰੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਆ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: paathar ddubadhaa kaadd leeaa saachee vaddiaaiee ||4||
verses.translation: He has lifted up the sinking stone; True is His glorious greatness. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bikh se a(n)mirat bhe gurmat budh paiee ||
verses.translation: From poison, I have been transformed into Ambrosial Nectar; under Guru's Instruction, I have obtained wisdom.

verses.original: ਅਕਹੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: akahu paramal bhe a(n)tar vaasanaa vasaiee ||5||
verses.translation: From bitter herbs, I have been transformed into sandalwood; this fragrance permeates me deep within. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: maanas janam dhula(n)bh hai jag meh khaTiaa aai ||
verses.translation: This human birth is so precious; one must earn the right to come into the world.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag satigur milai har naam dhiaai ||6||
verses.translation: By perfect destiny, I met the True Guru, and I meditate on the Lord's Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਗੇ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhoole bikh lage ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; attached to corruption, they waste away their lives in vain.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam sadhaa sukh saagar saachaa sabadh na bhaiaa ||7||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is forever an ocean of peace, but the manmukhs do not love the Word of the Shabad. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mukhahu har har sabh ko karai viralai hiradhai vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Everyone can chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with their mouths, but only a few enshrine it within their hearts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jin kai hiradhai vasiaa mokh mukat tin(h) paiaa ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, attain liberation and emancipation. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Wadahans, First Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kooR vigaaR kaahe naieeaai ||
verses.translation: Why bother to wash the body, polluted by falsehood?

verses.original: ਨਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: naataa so paravaan sach kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: One's cleansing bath is only approved, if he practices Truth.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਸਾਚ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jab saach a(n)dhar hoi saachaa taam saachaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: When there is Truth within the heart, then one becomes True, and obtains the True Lord.

verses.original: ਲਿਖੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: likhe baajhahu surat naahee bol bol gavaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without pre-ordained destiny, understanding is not attained; talking and babbling, one wastes his life away.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਿਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jithai jai baheeaai bhalaa kaheeaai surat sabadh likhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Wherever you go and sit, speak well, and write the Word of the Shabad in your consciousness.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kooR vigaaR kaahe naieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Why bother to wash the body which is polluted by falsehood? ||1||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਹਣੁ ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: taa mai kahiaa kahan jaa tujhai kahaiaa ||
verses.translation: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har kaa naam merai man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੂਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam meeThaa maneh laagaa dhookh dderaa ddaahiaa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, seems so sweet to my mind; it has destroyed the dwelling of pain.

verses.original: ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾਮਿ ਤੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sookh man meh aai vasiaa jaam tai furamaiaa ||
verses.translation: Peace came to dwell in my mind, when You gave the Order.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar tudh aradhaas meree ji(n)n aap upaiaa ||
verses.translation: It is Yours to bestow Your Grace, and it is mine to speak this prayer; You created Yourself.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਹਣੁ ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa mai kahiaa kahan jaa tujhai kahaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਾਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: vaaree khasam kaddaae kirat kamaavanaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa kisai na aakh jhagaRaa paavanaa ||
verses.translation: Do not speak ill of others, or get involved in arguments.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਪਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: neh pai jhagaRaa suaam setee aap aap van(j)aavanaa ||
verses.translation: Do not get into arguments with the Lord, or you shall ruin yourself.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਰੀਕੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naal sa(n)gat kar sareekee jai kiaa rooaavanaa ||
verses.translation: If you challenge the One, with whom you must abide, you will cry in the end.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸਹਣਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਆਖਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhei sahanaa maneh kahanaa aakh naahee vaavanaa ||
verses.translation: Be satisfied with what God gives you; tell your mind not to complain uselessly.

verses.original: ਵਾਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vaaree khasam kaddaae kirat kamaavanaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh upaieean aap aape nadhar kare ||
verses.translation: He Himself created all, and He blesses then with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਕਉੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਭ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: kauRaa koi na maagai meeThaa sabh maagai ||
verses.translation: No one asks for that which is bitter; everyone asks for sweets.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਮੀਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਖਸਮ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh koi meeThaa ma(n)g dhekhai khasam bhaavai so kare ||
verses.translation: Let everyone ask for sweets, and behold, it is as the Lord wills.

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਸਮਸਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kichh pu(n)n dhaan anek karanee naam tul na samasare ||
verses.translation: Giving donations to charity, and performing various religious rituals are not equal to the contemplation of the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: naanakaa jin naam miliaa karam hoaa dhur kadhe ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are blessed with the Naam have had such good karma pre-ordained.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh upaieean aap aape nadhar kare ||4||1||
verses.translation: He Himself created all, and He blesses them with His Glance of Grace. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: karahu dhiaa teraa naam vakhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Show mercy to me, that I may chant Your Name.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh upaieeaai aap aape sarab samaanaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created all, and You are pervading among all.

verses.original: ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sarabe samaanaa aap toohai upai dha(n)dhai laieeaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are pervading among all, and You link them to their tasks.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਜੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਿਖ ਭਵਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik tujh hee ke'ee raaje ikanaa bhikh bhavaieeaa ||
verses.translation: Some, You have made kings, while others go about begging.

verses.original: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਏਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: lobh moh tujh keeaa meeThaa et bharam bhulaanaa ||
verses.translation: You have made greed and emotional attachment seem sweet; they are deluded by this delusion.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਤਾਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa dhiaa karahu apanee taam naam vakhaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Be ever merciful to me; only then can I chant Your Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam teraa hai saachaa sadhaa mai man bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh giaa sukh aai samaanaa ||
verses.translation: My pains are dispelled, and I am permeated with peace.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan sur nar sughaR sujaanaa ||
verses.translation: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar sughaR sujaan gaaveh jo terai man bhaavahe ||
verses.translation: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You; they are pleasing to Your Mind.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mohe cheteh naahee ahilaa janam gavaavahe ||
verses.translation: Enticed by Maya, they do not remember the Lord, and they waste away their lives in vain.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik mooR mugadh na cheteh moole jo aaiaa tis jaanaa ||
verses.translation: Some fools and idiots never think of the Lord; whoever has come, shall have to go.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam teraa sadhaa saachaa soi mai man bhaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: teraa vakhat suhaavaa a(n)mrit teree baanee ||
verses.translation: Beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਉ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sevak seveh bhaau kar laagaa saau paraanee ||
verses.translation: Your servants serve You with love; these mortals are attached to Your essence.

verses.original: ਸਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saau praanee tinaa laagaa jinee a(n)mrit paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those mortals are attached to Your essence, who are blessed with the Ambrosial Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਿਤ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam terai joi raate nit chaReh savaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with Your Name, prosper more and more, day by day.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਾਮਿ ਨ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik karam dharam na hoi sa(n)jam jaam na ek pachhaanee ||
verses.translation: Some do not practice good deeds, or live righteously; nor do they practice self-restraint. They do not realize the One Lord.

verses.original: ਵਖਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vakhat suhaavaa sadhaa teraa a(n)mirat teree baanee ||3||
verses.translation: Ever beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree saache naavai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Name.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: raaj teraa kabahu na jaavai ||
verses.translation: Your rule shall never end.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੋ ਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: raajo ta teraa sadhaa nihachal eh kabahu na jaave ||
verses.translation: Your rule is eternal and unchanging; it shall never come to an end.

verses.original: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: chaakar ta teraa soi hovai joi sahaj samaave ||
verses.translation: He alone becomes Your servant, who contemplates You in peaceful ease.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਮੂਲੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman ta dhookh na lagai moole paap neR na aave ||
verses.translation: Enemies and pains shall never touch him, and sin shall never draw near him.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਾ ਏਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree sadhaa hovaa ek tere naave ||4||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the One Lord, and Your Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jugeh juga(n)tar bhagat tumaare || keerat kareh suaamee terai dhuaare ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, Your devotees sing the Kirtan of Your Praises, O Lord Master, at Your Door.

verses.original: ਜਪਹਿ ਤ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: japeh ta saachaa ek muraare ||
verses.translation: They meditate on the One True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਤਾਮਿ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਜਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa muraare taam jaapeh jaam ma(n)n vasaavahe ||
verses.translation: Only then do they meditate on the True Lord, when they enshrine Him in their minds.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੋ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਮਿ ਏਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: bharamo bhulaavaa tujheh keeaa jaam eh chukaavahe ||
verses.translation: Doubt and delusion are Your making; when these are dispelled,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਮਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee karahu kirapaa leh jamahu ubaare ||
verses.translation: then, by Guru's Grace, You grant Your Grace, and save them from the noose of Death.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jugeh juga(n)tar bhagat tumaare ||5||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, they are Your devotees. ||5||

verses.original: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: vadde mere saahibaa alakh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: O my Great Lord and Master, You are unfathomable and infinite.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar karau bena(n)tee hau aakh na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: How should I make and offer my prayer? I do not know what to say.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kareh taa saach pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: If You bless me with Your Glance of Grace, I realize the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੋ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: saacho pachhaanaa taam teraa jaam aap bujhaavahe ||
verses.translation: Only then do I come to realize the Truth, when You Yourself instruct me.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਹਸਾ ਏਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh bhookh sa(n)saar ke'ee sahasaa eh chukaavahe ||
verses.translation: The pain and hunger of the world are Your making; dispel this doubt.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak jai sahasaa bujhai gur beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, ones skepticism is taken away, when he understands the Guru's wisdom.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: vaddaa saahib hai aap alakh apaaraa ||6||
verses.translation: The Great Lord Master is unfathomable and infinite. ||6||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਦੰਤ ਰੀਸਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: tere ba(n)ke loin dha(n)t reesaalaa ||
verses.translation: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful.

verses.original: ਸੋਹਣੇ ਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਲੰਮੜੇ ਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sohane nak jin la(n)maRe vaalaa ||
verses.translation: Your nose is so graceful, and Your hair is so long.

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੀ ਢਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan kaiaa suine kee ddaalaa ||
verses.translation: Your body is so precious, cast in gold.

verses.original: ਸੋਵੰਨ ਢਾਲਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮਾਲਾ ਜਪਹੁ ਤੁਸੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: sova(n)n ddaalaa kirasan maalaa japahu tusee saheleeho ||
verses.translation: His body is cast in gold, and He wears Krishna's mala; meditate on Him, O sisters.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਹੁ ਖੜੀਆ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhuaar na hoh khaReeaa sikh sunahu maheleeho ||
verses.translation: You shall not have to stand at Death's door, O sisters, if you listen to these teachings.

verses.original: ਹੰਸ ਹੰਸਾ ਬਗ ਬਗਾ ਲਹੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s ha(n)saa bag bagaa lahai man kee jaalaa ||
verses.translation: From a crane, you shall be transformed into a swan, and the filth of your mind shall be removed.

verses.original: ਬੰਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਦੰਤ ਰੀਸਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ba(n)ke loin dha(n)t reesaalaa ||7||
verses.translation: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਮਧੁਰਾੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: teree chaal suhaavee madhuraaRee baanee ||
verses.translation: Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet.

verses.original: ਕੁਹਕਨਿ ਕੋਕਿਲਾ ਤਰਲ ਜੁਆਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kuhakan kokilaa taral juaanee ||
verses.translation: You coo like a songbird, and your youthful beauty is alluring.

verses.original: ਤਰਲਾ ਜੁਆਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਣੀ ਇਛ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: taralaa juaanee aap bhaanee ichh man kee poore'e ||
verses.translation: Your youthful beauty is so alluring; it pleases You, and it fulfills the heart's desires.

verses.original: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਪਗੁ ਧਰੈ ਠਿਮਿ ਠਿਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਸੰਧੂਰਏ ॥
verses.translit: saara(n)g jiau pag dharai Thim Thim aap aap sa(n)dhoore ||
verses.translation: Like an elephant, You step with Your Feet so carefully; You are satisfied with Yourself.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਾਤੀ ਉਦਕੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਵਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sreera(n)g raatee firai maatee udhak ga(n)gaa vaanee ||
verses.translation: She who is imbued with the Love of such a Great Lord, flows intoxicated, like the waters of the Ganges.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਮਧੁਰਾੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhaas har kaa teree chaal suhaavee madhuraaRee baanee ||8||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave, O Lord; Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਮੁਈਏ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
