verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to such a humble being. O Lord, You bless all with Your bountiful blessings. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tau bhaanaa taa(n) tirapat aghaae raam ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, then I am satisfied and satiated.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: man theeaa Tha(n)ddaa sabh tirasan bujhaae raam ||
verses.translation: My mind is soothed and calmed, and all my thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਡੰਝਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man theeaa Tha(n)ddaa chookee dda(n)jhaa paiaa bahut khajaanaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is soothed and calmed, the burning has ceased, and I have found so many treasures.

verses.original: ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਣ ਲਗੇ ਹੰਉ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sikh sevak sabh bhu(n)chan lage ha(n)au satagur kai kurabaanaa ||
verses.translation: All the Sikhs and servants partake of them; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਖਸਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhe khasam ra(n)g raate jam kee traas bujhaae ||
verses.translation: I have become fearless, imbued with the Love of my Lord Master, and I have shaken off the fear of death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੰਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sadhaa sa(n)g sevak teree bhagat kara(n)au liv laae ||3||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak, Your humble servant, lovingly embraces Your meditation; O Lord, be with me always. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਜੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: pooree aasaa jee manasaa mere raam ||
verses.translation: My hopes and desires have been fulfilled, O my Lord.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਜੀਉ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun jeeau sabh gun tere raam ||
verses.translation: I am worthless, without virtue; all virtues are Yours, O Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh gun tere Thaakur mere kit mukh tudh saalaahee ||
verses.translation: All virtues are Yours, O my Lord and Master; with what mouth should I praise You?

verses.original: ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun avagun meraa kichh na beechaariaa bakhas leeaa khin maahee ||
verses.translation: You did not consider my merits and demerits; you forgave me in an instant.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh paiee vajee vaadhaiee vaaje anahadh toore ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the nine treasures, congratulations are pouring in, and the unstruck melody resounds.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਥੇ ਜੀ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mai var ghar paiaa mere laathe jee sagal visoore ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord within my own home, and all my anxiety is forgotten. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਣੇਦੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਪਵਣ ਝੁਲਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa sunedho kooR va(n)n(j)n pavan jhulaariaa ||
verses.translation: Why do you listen to falsehood? It shall vanish like a gust of wind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak suneear te paravaan jo sunedhe sach dhanee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those ears are acceptable, which listen to the True Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tin ghol ghumaiee jin prabh sravanee suniaa raam ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who listen with their ears to the Lord God.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: se sahaj suhele jin har har rasanaa bhaniaa raam ||
verses.translation: Blissful and comfortable are those, who with their tongues chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: se sahaj suhele guneh amole jagat udhaaran aae ||
verses.translation: They are naturally embellished, with priceless virtues; they have come to save the world.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bohith saagar prabh charanaa kete paar laghaae ||
verses.translation: God's Feet are the boat, which carries so many across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin ka(n)au kirapaa karee merai Thaakur tin kaa lekhaa na ganiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with the favor of my Lord and Master, are not asked to render their account.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis ghol ghumaiee jin prabh sravanee suniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who listen to God with their ears. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: loin loiee ddiTh piaas na bujhai moo ghanee ||
verses.translation: With my eyes, I have seen the Light of the Lord, but my great thirst is not quenched.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਅਖੜੀਆਂ ਬਿਅੰਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਸੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak se akhaReeaa(n) bia(n)n jinee ddisa(n)dho maa piree ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those eyes are different, which behold my Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jinee har prabh ddiThaa tin kurabaane raam ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: se saachee dharageh bhaane raam ||
verses.translation: In the True Court of the Lord, they are approved.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur maane se paradhaane har setee ra(n)g raate ||
verses.translation: They are approved by their Lord and Master, and acclaimed as supreme; they are imbued with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: har raseh aghaae sahaj samaae ghaT ghaT ramieeaa jaate ||
verses.translation: They are satiated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and they merge in celestial peace; in each and every heart, they see the all-pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: seiee sajan sa(n)t se sukhe'ee Thaakur apane bhaane ||
verses.translation: They alone are the friendly Saints, and they alone are happy, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jin har prabh ddiThaa tin kai sadh kurabaane ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheh a(n)dhaaree a(n)dh su(n)n(j)ee naam vihooneeaa ||
verses.translation: The body is blind, totally blind and desolate, without the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak safal jana(n)m jai ghaT vuThaa sach dhanee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, fruitful is the life of that being, within whose heart the True Lord and Master abides. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾਂ ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tin kha(n)neeaai va(n)n(j)aa(n) jin meraa har prabh ddeeThaa raam ||
verses.translation: I am cut into pieces as a sacrifice, to those who have seen my Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਚਾਖਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jan chaakh aghaane har har a(n)mrit meeThaa raam ||
verses.translation: His humble servants partake of the Sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, and are satiated.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੂਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: har maneh meeThaa prabhoo tooThaa amiau vooThaa sukh bhe ||
verses.translation: The Lord seems sweet to their minds; God is merciful to them, His Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon them, and they are at peace.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਈਸਹ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh naas bharam binaas tan te jap jagadhees ieeseh jai je ||
verses.translation: Pain is eliminated and doubt is dispelled from the body; chanting the Name of the Lord of the World, their victory is celebrated.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: moh rahat bikaar thaake pa(n)ch te sa(n)g tooTaa ||
verses.translation: They are rid of emotional attachment, their sins are erased, and their association with the five passions is broken off.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਜਿਨ ਘਟਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tin kha(n)neeaai va(n)n(j)aa jin ghaT meraa har prabh vooThaa ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am every bit a sacrifice to those, within whose hearts my Lord God abides. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਲੋੜੀਦੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo loReedhe raam sevak seiee kaa(n)ddiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who long for the Lord, are said to be His servants.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੇ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jaane sat saa(n)iee sa(n)t na baaharaa ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak knows this Truth, that the Lord is not different from His Saint. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਖਟਾਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mil jal jaleh khaTaanaa raam ||
verses.translation: As water mixes and blends with water,

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g jotee jot milaanaa raam ||
verses.translation: so does one's light mix and blend with the Lord's Light.

verses.original: ਸੰਮਾਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)mai pooran purakh karate aap aapeh jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Merging with the perfect, all-powerful Creator, one comes to know his own self.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: teh su(n)n sahaj samaadh laagee ek ek vakhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Then, he enters the celestial state of absolute Samaadhi, and speaks of the One and Only Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap gupataa aap mukataa aap aap vakhaanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is liberated; He Himself speaks of Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhram bhai gun binaase mil jal jaleh khaTaanaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, doubt, fear and the limitations of the three qualities are dispelled, as one merges into the Lord, like water blending with water. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: prabh karan kaaran samarathaa raam ||
verses.translation: God is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਰਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੇ ਹਥਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: rakh jagat sagal dhe hathaa raam ||
verses.translation: He preserves the whole world, reaching out with His hand.

verses.original: ਸਮਰਥ ਸਰਣਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: samarath saranaa jog suaamee kirapaa nidh sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: He is the all-powerful, safe Sanctuary, Lord and Master, Treasure of mercy, Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)au kurabaanee dhaas tere jinee ek pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your slaves, who recognize only the One Lord.

verses.original: ਵਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਲਖਿਆ ਕਥਨ ਤੇ ਅਕਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: varan chihan na jai lakhiaa kathan te akathaa ||
verses.translation: His color and shape cannot be seen; His description is indescribable.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sunahu binatee prabh karan kaaran samarathaa ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, hear my prayer, O God, Almighty Creator, Cause of causes. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: eh jeea tere too karataa raam ||
verses.translation: These beings are Yours; You are their Creator.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਹਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhookh dharadh bhram harataa raam ||
verses.translation: God is the Destroyer of pain, suffering and doubt.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhram dhookh dharadh nivaar khin meh rakh leh dheen dhaiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Eliminate my doubt, pain and suffering in an instant, and preserve me, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa suaam sajan sabh jagat baal gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: You are mother, father and friend, O Lord and Master; the whole world is Your child, O Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo saran aavai gun nidhaan paavai so bahuR janam na marataa ||
verses.translation: One who comes seeking Your Sanctuary, obtains the treasure of virtue, and does not have to enter the cycle of birth and death again.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhaas teraa sabh jeea tere too karataa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. All beings are Yours; You are their Creator. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har dhiaaieeaai raam ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: man ichhiaRaa fal paieeaai raam ||
verses.translation: the fruits of the heart's desires are obtained.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: man ichh paieeaai prabh dhiaaieeaai miTeh jam ke traasaa ||
verses.translation: Your heart's desires are obtained, meditating on God, and the fear of death is dispelled.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh gaiaa saadh sa(n)gaiaa bhiee pooran aasaa ||
verses.translation: I sing of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and my hopes are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan moh vikaar sagale prabhoo kai man bhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Renouncing egotism, emotional attachment and all corruption, we become pleasing to the Mind of God.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhinas rainee sadhaa har har dhiaaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, day and night, meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhar vaajeh anahat vaaje raam ||
verses.translation: At the Lord's Door, the unstruck melody resounds.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT har gobi(n)dh gaaje raam ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, sings.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਗਾਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਊਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: govidh gaaje sadhaa biraaje agam agochar uoochaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe sings, and abides forever; He is unfathomable, profoundly deep, lofty and exalted.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun bea(n)t kichh kahan na jaiee koi na sakai pahoochaa ||
verses.translation: His virtues are infinite - none of them can be described. No one can reach Him.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae aap pratipaale jeea ja(n)t sabh saaje ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates, and He Himself sustains; all beings and creatures are fashioned by Him.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sukh naam bhagatee dhar vajeh anahadh vaaje ||4||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, happiness comes from devotional worship of the Naam; at His Door, the unstruck melody resounds. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਅਲਾਹਣੀਆ
verses.translit: raag vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa ghar panjavaa alaahaneeaa
verses.translation: Raag Wadahans, First Mehla, Fifth House, Alaahanees ~ Songs Of Mourning:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n sira(n)dhaa sachaa paatisaahu jin jag dha(n)dhai laiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks.

verses.original: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁਨੀ ਪਾਈ ਭਰੀ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: muhalat punee paiee bharee jaaneeaRaa ghat chalaiaa ||
verses.translation: When one's time is up, and the measure is full, this dear soul is caught, and driven off.

verses.original: ਜਾਨੀ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਵੀਰ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaanee ghat chalaiaa likhiaa aaiaa ru(n)ne veer sabaae ||
verses.translation: This dear soul is driven off, when the pre-ordained Order is received, and all the relatives cry out in mourning.

verses.original: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਥੀਆ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਜਾਂ ਦਿਨ ਪੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)iaa ha(n)s theeaa vechhoRaa jaa(n) dhin pu(n)ne meree maae ||
verses.translation: The body and the swan-soul are separated, when one's days are past and done, O my mother.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa likhiaa tehaa paiaa jehaa purab kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: As is one's pre-ordained Destiny, so does one receive, according to one's past actions.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n sira(n)dhaa sachaa paatisaahu jin jag dha(n)dhai laiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: saahib simarahu mere bhaieeho sabhanaa eh piaanaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyone has to pass this way.

verses.original: ਏਥੈ ਧੰਧਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ethai dha(n)dhaa kooRaa chaar dhihaa aagai sarapar jaanaa ||
verses.translation: These false entanglements last for only a few days; then, one must surely move on to the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aagai sarapar jaanaa jiau mihamaanaa kaahe gaarab keejai ||
verses.translation: He must surely move on to the world hereafter, like a guest; so why does he indulge in ego?

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jit seviaai dharageh sukh paieeaai naam tisai kaa leejai ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord; serving Him, you shall obtain peace in His Court.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਹਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: aagai hukam na chalai moole sir sir kiaa vihaanaa ||
verses.translation: In the world hereafter, no one's commands will be obeyed. According to their actions, each and every person proceeds.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਿਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saahib simarih mere bhaieeho sabhanaa eh piaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyone has to pass this way. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੀਲੜਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai sa(n)mrath so theeaai heelaRaa eh sa(n)saaro ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਾਚੜਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa saachaRaa sirajanahaaro ||
verses.translation: The True Creator Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the air.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa sirajanahaaro alakh apaaro taa kaa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Creator Lord is invisible and infinite; His limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa tin kaa safal bhiaa hai ik man jinee dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the coming of those, who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

verses.original: ਢਾਹੇ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: ddaahe ddaeh usaare aape hukam savaaranahaaro ||
verses.translation: He destroys, and having destroyed, He creates; by His Order, He adorns us.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੀਲੜਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai sa(n)mrath so theeaai heelaRaa eh sa(n)saaro ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ru(n)naa baabaa jaaneeaai je rovai lai piaaro ||
verses.translation: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਵਾਲੇਵੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਰੋਵਣੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: vaaleve kaaran baabaa roieeaai rovan sagal bikaaro ||
verses.translation: One who weeps for the sake of worldly objects, O Baba, weeps totally in vain.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਣੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ਗਾਫਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: rovan sagal bikaaro gaafal sa(n)saaro maiaa kaaran rovai ||
verses.translation: This weeping is all in vain; the world forgets the Lord, and weeps for the sake of Maya.

verses.original: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)gaa ma(n)dhaa kichh soojhai naahee ih tan evai khovai ||
verses.translation: He does not distinguish between good and evil, and wastes away this life in vain.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai aaiaa sabh ko jaasee kooR karahu aha(n)kaaro ||
verses.translation: Everyone who comes here, shall have to leave; to act in ego is false.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ru(n)naa baabaa jaaneeaai je rovai lai piaaro ||4||1||
verses.translation: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu milahu saheleeho sachaRaa naam lehaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੇਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: roveh birahaa tan kaa aapanaa saahib sa(n)m(h)aalehaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Let us weep over the body's separation from the Lord and Master; let us remember Him in contemplation.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਹ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਹ ਅਸਾ ਭਿ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: saahib sam(h)aaleh pa(n)th nihaaleh asaa bh othai jaanaa ||
verses.translation: Let us remember the Lord and Master in contemplation, and keep a watchful eye on the Path. We shall have to go there as well.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa keeaa tin hee leeaa hoaa tisai kaa bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: He who has created, also destroys; whatever happens is by His Will.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਇਆ ਅਸੀ ਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo tin kar paiaa su aagai aaiaa asee k hukam karehaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever He has done, has come to pass; how can we command Him?

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਹਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavahu milahu saheleeho sachaRaa naam lehaa ||1||
verses.translation: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maran na ma(n)dhaa lokaa aakheeaai je mar jaanai aaisaa koi ||
verses.translation: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sevih saahib sa(n)mrath aapanaa pa(n)th suhelaa aagai hoi ||
verses.translation: Serve your Almighty Lord and Master, and your path in the world hereafter will be easy.

verses.original: ਪੰਥਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)th suhelai jaavahu taa(n) fal paavahu aagai milai vaddaiee ||
verses.translation: Take this easy path, and you shall obtain the fruits of your rewards, and receive honor in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਭੇਟੈ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bheTai siau jaavahu sach samaavahu taa(n) pat lekhai paiee ||
verses.translation: Go there with your offering, and you shall merge in the True Lord; your honor shall be confirmed.

verses.original: ਮਹਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: mahalee jai paavahu khasamai bhaavahu ra(n)g siau raleeaa maanai ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain a place in the Mansion of the Lord Master's Presence; being pleasing to Him, you shall enjoy the pleasures of His Love.

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maran na ma(n)dhaa lokaa aakheeaai je koiee mar jaanai ||2||
verses.translation: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾ ਸੂਰਿਆ ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਨਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: maran munasaa sooriaa hak hai jo hoi maran paravaano ||
verses.translation: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God.

verses.original: ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਆਗੈ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: soore seiee aagai aakhe'eeh dharageh paaveh saachee maano ||
verses.translation: They alone are acclaimed as brave warriors in the world hereafter, who receive true honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh maan paaveh pat siau jaaveh aagai dhookh na laagai ||
verses.translation: They are honored in the Court of the Lord; they depart with honor, and they do not suffer pain in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar ek dhiaaveh taa(n) fal paaveh jit seviaai bhau bhaagai ||
verses.translation: They meditate on the One Lord, and obtain the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord, their fear is dispelled.

verses.original: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: uoochaa nahee kahanaa man meh rahanaa aape jaanai jaano ||
verses.translation: Do not indulge in egotism, and dwell within your own mind; the Knower Himself knows everything.

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾਂ ਸੂਰਿਆ ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maran munasaa(n) sooriaa hak hai jo hoi mareh paravaano ||3||
verses.translation: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kis no baabaa roieeaai baajee hai ih sa(n)saaro ||
verses.translation: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play.

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa vekhai saahib aapanaa kudharat kare beechaaro ||
verses.translation: The Lord Master beholds His work, and contemplates His creative potency.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਧਾਰਣ ਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat beechaare dhaaran dhaare jin keeaa so jaanai ||
verses.translation: He contemplates His creative potency, having established the Universe. He who created it, He alone knows.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape vekhai aape boojhai aape hukam pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: He Himself beholds it, and He Himself understands it. He Himself realizes the Hukam of His Command.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jin kichh keeaa soiee jaanai taa kaa roop apaaro ||
verses.translation: He who created these things, He alone knows. His subtle form is infinite.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kis no baabaa roieeaai baajee hai ih sa(n)saaro ||4||2||
verses.translation: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa dhakhanee ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, First Mehla, Dakhanee:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੜਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: sach sira(n)dhaa sachaa jaaneeaai sachaRaa paravadhagaaro ||
verses.translation: The True Creator Lord is True - know this well; He is the True Sustainer.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਸਚੜਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jin aapeenai aap saajiaa sachaRaa alakh apaaro ||
verses.translation: He Himself fashioned His Own Self; the True Lord is invisible and infinite.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: dhui puR joR vichhoRian gur bin ghor a(n)dhaaro ||
verses.translation: He brought together, and then separated, the two grinding stones of the earth and the sky; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

verses.original: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਅਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sooraj cha(n)dh sirajian ahinis chalat veechaaro ||1||
verses.translation: He created the sun and the moon; night and day, they move according to His Thought. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੜਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sachaRaa saahib sach too sachaRaa dheh piaaro || rahaau ||
verses.translation: O True Lord and Master, You are True. O True Lord, bless me with Your Love. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: tudh sirajee medhanee dhukh sukh dhevanahaaro ||
verses.translation: You created the Universe; You are the Giver of pain and pleasure.

verses.original: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਿਰਜਿਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: naaree purakh sirajiaai bikh maiaa moh piaaro ||
verses.translation: You created woman and man, the love of poison, and emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: khaanee baanee tereeaa dheh jeeaa aadhaaro ||
verses.translation: The four sources of creation, and the power of the Word, are also of Your making. You give Support to all beings.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kudharat takhat rachaiaa sach nibeRanahaaro ||2||
verses.translation: You have made the Creation as Your Throne; You are the True Judge. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gavan sirajiaa too thir karanaihaaro ||
verses.translation: You created comings and goings, but You are ever-stable, O Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਬਧਿਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maranaa aai giaa badhik jeeau bikaaro ||
verses.translation: In birth and death, in coming and going, this soul is held in bondage by corruption.

verses.original: ਭੂਡੜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬੂਡੜੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: bhooddaRai naam visaariaa booddaRai kiaa tis chaaro ||
verses.translation: The evil person has forgotten the Naam; he has drowned - what can he do now?

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gun chhodd bikh ladhiaa avagun kaa vanajaaro ||3||
verses.translation: Forsaking merit, he has loaded the poisonous cargo of demerits; he is a trader of sins. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਦੜੇ ਆਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਾਨੀਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaRe aae tinaa jaaneeaa hukam sache karataaro ||
verses.translation: The beloved soul has received the Call, the Command of the True Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: naaree purakh vichhu(n)niaa vichhuRiaa melanahaaro ||
verses.translation: The soul, the husband, has become separated from the body, the bride. The Lord is the Re-uniter of the separated ones.

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਹਣੀਐ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਧੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: roop na jaanai sohaneeaai hukam badhee sir kaaro ||
verses.translation: No one cares for your beauty, O beautiful bride.; the Messenger of Death is bound only by the Lord Commander's Command.

verses.original: ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤੋੜਨਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: baalak biradh na jaananee toRan het piaaro ||4||
verses.translation: He does not distinguish between young children and old people; he tears apart love and affection. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nau dhar Thaake hukam sachai ha(n)s giaa gainaare ||
verses.translation: The nine doors are closed by the True Lord's Command, and the swan-soul takes flight into the skies.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਛੁਟੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਧਣੀਆ ਮਿਰਤਕੜਾ ਅੰਙਨੜੇ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan chhuTee muThee jhooTh vidhaneeaa mritakaRaa a(n)n(g)naRe baare ||
verses.translation: The body-bride is separated, and defrauded by falsehood; she is now a widow - her husband's body lies dead in the courtyard.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਈ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਈਏ ਮਹਲ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: surat muiee mar maie'ee mahal ru(n)nee dhar baare ||
verses.translation: The widow cries out at the door, ""The light of my mind has gone out, O my mother, with his death.""

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: rovahu ka(n)t maheleeho sache ke gun saare ||5||
verses.translation: So cry out, O soul-brides of the Husband Lord, and dwell on the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਨਾਵਾਲਿਆ ਕਪੜਿ ਪਟਿ ਅੰਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jal mal jaanee naavaaliaa kapaR paT a(n)baare ||
verses.translation: Her loved one is cleansed, bathed in water, and dressed in silken robes.

verses.original: ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜੇ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਪੰਚ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaaje vaje sachee baaneeaa pa(n)ch mue man maare ||
verses.translation: The musicians play, and the Bani of the True Lord's Words are sung; the five relatives feel as if they too are dead, so deadened are their minds.

verses.original: ਜਾਨੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੜੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaanee vichhu(n)naRe meraa maran bhiaa dhirag jeevan sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: "Separation from my beloved is like death to me!" cries the widow. "My life in this world is cursed and worthless!"

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਸਚੜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai su jaaneeaai pir sachaRai het piaare ||6||
verses.translation: But she alone is approved, who dies, while yet still alive; she lives for the sake of the Love of her Beloved. ||6||

verses.original: ਤੁਸੀ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਵਣ ਆਈਹੋ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tusee rovahu rovan aaieeho jhooTh muThee sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: So cry out in mourning, you who have come to mourn; this world is false and fraudulent.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਣੀਆ ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਵਿਧਣਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau muThaRee dha(n)dhai dhaavaneeaa pir chhoddiaRee vidhanakaare ||
verses.translation: I too have been defrauded, chasing after worldly entanglements; my Husband Lord has forsaken me - I practice the evil deeds of a wife without a spouse.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਰੂੜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar ka(n)t maheleeaa rooRai het piaare ||
verses.translation: In each and every home, are the brides of the Husband Lord; they gaze upon their Handsome Lord with love and affection.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਉ ਰਹਸਿਅੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: mai pir sach saalaahanaa hau rahasiaRee naam bhataare ||7||
verses.translation: I sing the Praises of my True Husband Lord, and through the Naam, the Name of my Husband Lord, I blossom forth. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਵੇਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai ves palaTiaa saa dhan sach seegaaro ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the soul-bride's dress is transformed, and she is adorned with Truth.

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu milahu saheleeho simarahu sirajanahaaro ||
verses.translation: Come and meet with me, O brides of the Lord; let's meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: bieear naam suohaaganee sach savaaranahaaro ||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, the soul-bride becomes the Lord's favorite; she is adorned with Truth.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਹੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: gaavahu geet na birahaRaa naanak braham beechaaro ||8||3||
verses.translation: Do not sing the songs of separation, O Nanak; reflect upon God. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin jag siraj samaiaa so saahib kudharat jaanovaa ||
verses.translation: The One who creates and dissolves the world - that Lord and Master alone knows His creative power.

verses.original: ਸਚੜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachaRaa dhoor na bhaaleeaai ghaT ghaT sabadh pachhaanovaa ||
verses.translation: Do not search for the True Lord far away; recognize the Word of the Shabad in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach sabadh pachhaanahu dhoor na jaanahu jin eh rachanaa raachee ||
verses.translation: Recognize the Shabad, and do not think that the Lord is far away; He created this creation.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿੜ ਕਾਚੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaae taa sukh paae bin naavai piR kaachee ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains peace; without the Naam, he plays a losing game.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਵਖਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jin thaapee bidh jaanai soiee kiaa ko kahai vakhaano ||
verses.translation: The One who established the Universe, He alone knows the Way; what can anyone say?

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਵਤਾਇਆ ਜਾਲੋੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin jag thaap vataiaa jaaluo so saahib paravaano ||1||
verses.translation: The One who established the world cast the net of Maya over it; accept Him as your Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਅਧ ਪੰਧੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa aaiaa hai uTh chalanaa adh pa(n)dhai hai sa(n)saarovaa ||
verses.translation: O Baba, he has come, and now he must get up and depart; this world is only a way-station.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਚੜੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sir sir sachaRai likhiaa dhukh sukh purab veechaarovaa ||
verses.translation: Upon each and every head, the True Lord writes their destiny of pain and pleasure, according to their past actions.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh dheeaa jehaa keeaa so nibahai jeea naale ||
verses.translation: He bestows pain and pleasure, according to the deeds done; the record of these deeds stays with the soul.

verses.original: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jehe karam karaae karataa dhoojee kaar na bhaale ||
verses.translation: He does those deeds which the Creator Lord causes him to do; he attempts no other actions.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aap niraalam dha(n)dhai baadhee kar hukam chhaddaavanahaaro ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is detached, while the world is entangled in conflict; by His Command, He emancipates it.

verses.original: ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aj kal karadhiaa kaal biaapai dhoojai bhai vikaaro ||2||
verses.translation: He may put this off today, but tomorrow he is seized by death; in love with duality, he practices corruption. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਉਝੜੁ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jam maarag pa(n)th na sujhiee ujhaR a(n)dh gubaarovaa ||
verses.translation: The path of death is dark and dismal; the way cannot be seen.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਲੇਫ ਤੁਲਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਰਕਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa jal lef tulaieeaa naa bhojan parakaarovaa ||
verses.translation: There is no water, no quilt or mattress, and no food there.

verses.original: ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: bhojan bhaau na Tha(n)ddaa paanee naa kaapaR seegaaro ||
verses.translation: He receives no food there, no honor or water, no clothes or decorations.

verses.original: ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਊਭੌ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: gal sa(n)gal sir maare uoobhau naa dheesai ghar baaro ||
verses.translation: The chain is put around his neck, and the Messenger of Death standing over his head strikes him; he cannot see the door of his home.

verses.original: ਇਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਹੇ ਜੰਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: eib ke raahe ja(n)man naahee pachhutaane sir bhaaro ||
verses.translation: The seeds planted on this path do not sprout; bearing the weight of his sins upon his head, he regrets and repents.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin saache ko belee naahee saachaa eh beechaaro ||3||
verses.translation: Without the True Lord, no one is his friend; reflect upon this as true. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa roveh raveh su jaane'eeh mil rovai gun saarevaa ||
verses.translation: O Baba, they alone are known to truly weep and wail, who meet together and weep, chanting the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰੋਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਧੰਧੜਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: rovai maiaa muThaRee dha(n)dhaRaa rovanahaarevaa ||
verses.translation: Defrauded by Maya and worldly affairs, the weepers weep.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa rovai mail na dhovai supana(n)tar sa(n)saaro ||
verses.translation: They weep for the sake of worldly affairs, and they do not wash off their own filth; the world is merely a dream.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮੈ ਭੂਲੈ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jiau baajeegar bharamai bhoolai jhooTh muThee aha(n)kaaro ||
verses.translation: Like the juggler, deceiving by his tricks, one is deluded by egotism, falsehood and illusion.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape maarag paavanahaaraa aape karam kamaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself reveals the Path; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam rate gur poorai raakhe naanak sahaj subhaae ||4||4||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam, are protected by the Perfect Guru, O Nanak; they merge in celestial bliss. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa aaiaa hai uTh chalanaa ih jag jhooTh pasaarovaa ||
verses.translation: O Baba, whoever has come, will rise up and leave; this world is merely a false show.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਘਰੁ ਸਚੜੈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੋਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa ghar sachaRai seveeaai sach kharaa sachiaarovaa ||
verses.translation: One's true home is obtained by serving the True Lord; real Truth is obtained by being truthful.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿ ਲਬਿ ਜਾਂ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਠਾਓ ॥
verses.translit: kooR lab jaa(n) thai na paasee agai lahai na Thaao ||
verses.translation: By falsehood and greed, no place of rest is found, and no place in the world hereafter is obtained.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਉ ਨ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਓ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar aau na baisahu kaheeaai jiau su(n)n(j)ai ghar kaao ||
verses.translation: No one invites him to come in and sit down. He is like a crow in a deserted home.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran vaddaa vechhoRaa binasai jag sabaae ||
verses.translation: Trapped by birth and death, he is separated from the Lord for such a long time; the whole world is wasting away.

verses.original: ਲਬਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਰੂਆਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lab dha(n)dhai maiaa jagat bhulaiaa kaal khaRaa rooaae ||1||
verses.translation: Greed, worldly entanglements and Maya deceive the world. Death hovers over its head, and causes it to weep. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਵਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੇਹ ਆਸੀਸਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa aavahu bhaieeho gal mileh mil mil dheh aaseesaa he ||
verses.translation: Come, O Baba, and Siblings of Destiny - let's join together; take me in your arms, and bless me with your prayers.

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਚੜਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹ ਅਸੀਸਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa sachaRaa mel na chukiee preetam keeaa dheh aseesaa he ||
verses.translation: O Baba, union with the True Lord cannot be broken; bless me with your prayers for union with my Beloved.

verses.original: ਆਸੀਸਾ ਦੇਵਹੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਵਹੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: aaseesaa dhevaho bhagat karevaho miliaa kaa kiaa melo ||
verses.translation: Bless me with your prayers, that I may perform devotional worship service to my Lord; for those already united with Him, what is there to unite?

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਥੇਹਹੁ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhoole naavahu thehahu thaavahu gur sabadhee sach khelo ||
verses.translation: Some have wandered away from the Name of the Lord, and lost the Path. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the true game.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਵੇਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: jam maarag nahee jaanaa sabadh samaanaa jug jug saachai vese ||
verses.translation: Do not go on Death's path; remain merged in the Word of the Shabad, the true form throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਣ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਫਾਸੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saajan sain milahu sa(n)jogee gur mil khole faase ||2||
verses.translation: Through good fortune, we meet such friends and relatives, who meet with the Guru, and escape the noose of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਂਗੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa naa(n)gaRaa aaiaa jag meh dhukh sukh lekh likhaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Baba, we come into the world naked, into pain and pleasure, according to the record of our account.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਨਾ ਟਲੈ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaRaa saahaa naa Talai jehaRaa purab kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: The call of our pre-ordained destiny cannot be altered; it follows from our past actions.

verses.original: ਬਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: beh saachai likhiaa a(n)mrit bikhiaa jit laiaa tit laagaa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord sits and writes of ambrosial nectar, and bitter poison; as the Lord attaches us, so are we attached.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰੀ ਕਾਮਣ ਪਾਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਗਲਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaamaniaaree kaaman paae bahu ra(n)gee gal taagaa ||
verses.translation: The Charmer, Maya, has worked her charms, and the multi-colored thread is around everyone's neck.

verses.original: ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਛਾ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾ ਮਖੀ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hochhee mat bhiaa man hochhaa guR saa makhee khaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through shallow intellect, the mind becomes shallow, and one eats the fly, along with the sweets.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਾਂਗੋ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naa marajaadh aaiaa kal bheetar naa(n)go ba(n)dh chalaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Contrary to custom, he comes into the Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and naked he is bound down and sent away again. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਰੋਵਣਾ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa rovahu je kisai rovanaa jaaneeaRaa ba(n)dh paThaiaa hai ||
verses.translation: O Baba, weep and mourn if you must; the beloved soul is bound and driven off.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਦਰਿ ਹਾਕਾਰੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaRaa lekh na meTeeaai dhar haakaaraRaa aaiaa hai ||
verses.translation: The pre-ordained record of destiny cannot be erased; the summons has come from the Lord's Court.

verses.original: ਹਾਕਾਰਾ ਆਇਆ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: haakaaraa aaiaa jaa tis bhaiaa ru(n)ne rovanahaare ||
verses.translation: The messenger comes, when it pleases the Lord, and the mourners begin to mourn.

verses.original: ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਤੀਜੇ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: put bhaiee bhaateeje roveh preetam at piaare ||
verses.translation: Sons, brothers, nephews and very dear friends weep and wail.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕੋ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai rovai gun saar samaale ko marai na muiaa naale ||
verses.translation: Let him weep, who weeps in the Fear of God, cherishing the virtues of God. No one dies with the dead.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣ ਸਿਜਾਣਾ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jug jug jaan sijaanaa roveh sach samaale ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, throughout the ages, they are known as wise, who weep, remembering the True Lord. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ਤੀਜਾ
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa mahalaa teejaa
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh sachaRaa har saalaaheeaai kaaraj sabh kichh karanai jog ||
verses.translation: Praise God, the True Lord; He is all-powerful to do all things.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਡ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਬੈਸਈ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan ra(n)dd na kabahoo baisiee naa kadhe hovai sog ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride shall never be a widow, and she shall never have to endure suffering.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naa kadhe hovai sog anadhin ras bhog saa dhan mahal samaanee ||
verses.translation: She shall never suffer - night and day, she enjoys pleasures; that soul-bride merges in the Mansion of her Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin priau jaataa karam bidhaataa bole a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: She knows her Beloved, the Architect of karma, and she speaks words of ambrosial sweetness.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਹਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਲਗੈ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)teeaa gun saareh apane ka(n)t samaaleh naa kadhe lagai vijogo ||
verses.translation: The virtuous soul-brides dwell on the Lord's virtues; they keep their Husband Lord in their remembrance, and so they never suffer separation from Him.

verses.original: ਸਚੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachaRaa pir saalaaheeaai sabh kichh karanai jogo ||1||
verses.translation: So praise your True Husband Lord, who is all-powerful to do all things. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachaRaa saahib sabadh pachhaaneeaai aape le milaae ||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master is realized through the Word of His Shabad; He blends all with Himself.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan pria kai ra(n)g ratee vichahu aap gavaae ||
verses.translation: That soul-bride is imbued with the Love of her Husband Lord, who banishes her self-conceit from within.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: vichahu aap gavaae fir kaal na khaae gurmukh eko jaataa ||
verses.translation: Eradicating her ego from within herself, death shall not consume her again; as Gurmukh, she knows the One Lord God.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman ichh pu(n)nee a(n)tar bhi(n)nee miliaa jagajeevan dhaataa ||
verses.translation: The desire of the soul-bride is fulfilled; deep within herself, she is drenched in His Love. She meets the Great Giver, the Life of the World.

verses.original: ਸਬਦ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਾਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ra(n)g raatee joban maatee pir kai a(n)k samaae ||
verses.translation: Imbued with love for the Shabad, she is like a youth intoxicated; she merges into the very being of her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sachaRaa saahib sabadh pachhaaneeaai aape le milaae ||2||
verses.translation: The True Lord Master is realized through the Word of His Shabad. He blends all with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jinee aapanaa ka(n)t pachhaaniaa hau tin poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||
verses.translation: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd sevaa karee pir sachaRaa milai sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: Renouncing ego, I serve them; thus I meet my True Husband Lord, with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਏ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: pir sachaa milai aae saach kamaae saach sabadh dhan raatee ||
verses.translation: The True Husband Lord comes to meet the soul-bride who practices Truth, and is imbued with the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰਾਂਡ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: kadhe na raa(n)dd sadhaa sohaagan a(n)tar sahaj samaadhee ||
verses.translation: She shall never become a widow; she shall always be a happy bride. Deep within herself, she dwells in the celestial bliss of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pir rahiaa bharapoore vekh hadhoore ra(n)g maane sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: Her Husband Lord is fully pervading everywhere; beholding Him ever-present, she enjoys His Love, with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jinee aapanaa ka(n)t pachhaaniaa hau tin poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||3||
verses.translation: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pirahu vichhu(n)neeaa bhee mileh je satigur laageh saache paae ||
verses.translation: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the Feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sadhaa dhiaal hai avagun sabadh jalaae ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is forever merciful; through the Word of His Shabad, demerits are burnt away.

verses.original: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaugun sabadh jalaae dhoojaa bhaau gavaae sache hee sach raatee ||
verses.translation: Burning away her demerits through the Shabad, the soul-bride eradicates her love of duality, and remains absorbed in the True, True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh sadhaa sukh paiaa haumai giee bharaatee ||
verses.translation: Through the True Shabad, everlasting peace is obtained, and egotism and doubt are dispelled.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: pir niramail sadhaa sukhadhaataa naanak sabadh milaae ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Husband Lord is forever the Giver of peace; O Nanak, through the Word of His Shabad, He is met.

verses.original: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: pirahu vichhu(n)neeaa bhee mileh je satigur laageh saache paae ||4||1||
verses.translation: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: suniahu ka(n)t maheleeho pir sevih sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: avaganava(n)tee pir na jaaniee muThee rovai ka(n)t visaar ||
verses.translation: The worthless bride does not know her Husband Lord - she is deluded; forgetting her Husband Lord, she weeps and wails.

verses.original: ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਸੰਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: rovai ka(n)t sa(n)maal sadhaa gun saar naa pir marai na jaae ||
verses.translation: She weeps, thinking of her Husband Lord, and she cherishes His virtues; her Husband Lord does not die, and does not leave.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaataa sabadh pachhaataa saachai prem samaae ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, she knows the Lord; through the Word of His Shabad, He is realized; through True Love, she merges with Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin apanaa pir nahee jaataa karam bidhaataa kooR muThee kooRiaare ||
verses.translation: She who does not know her Husband Lord, the Architect of karma, is deluded by falsehood - she herself is false.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: suniahu ka(n)t maheleeho pir sevih sabadh veechaare ||1||
verses.translation: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag aap upaion aavan jaan sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh khuaaian mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaaraa ||
verses.translation: The love of Maya has ruined the world; people die, to be re-born, over and over again.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ਵਧਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਮੂਠੀ ॥
verses.translit: mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaaraa vadheh bikaaraa giaan vihoonee mooThee ||
verses.translation: People die to be re-born, over and over again, while their sins increase; without spiritual wisdom, they are deluded.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਰੋਵੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai pir na paio janam gavaio rovai avaguniaaree jhooThee ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, the Husband Lord is not found; the worthless, false bride wastes her life away, weeping and wailing.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੋਈਐ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir jagajeevan kis no roieeaai rovai ka(n)t visaare ||
verses.translation: He is my Beloved Husband Lord, the Life of the World - for whom should I weep? They alone weep, who forget their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh jag aap upaion aavan jaan sa(n)saare ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so pir sachaa sadh hee saachaa hai naa oh marai na jaae ||
verses.translation: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave.

verses.original: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਧਨ ਇਆਣੀਆ ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolee firai dhan iaaneeaa ra(n)dd baiThee dhoojai bhaae ||
verses.translation: The ignorant soul-bride wanders in delusion; in the love of duality, she sits like a widow.

verses.original: ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)dd baiThee dhoojai bhaae maiaa moh dhukh paae aav ghaTai tan chheejai ||
verses.translation: She sits like a widow, in the love of duality; through emotional attachment to Maya, she suffers in pain. She is growing old, and her body is withering away.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਸੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh aaiaa sabh kichh jaasee dhukh laagaa bhai dhoojai ||
verses.translation: Whatever has come, all that shall pass away; through the love of duality, they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਝੈ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaal na soojhai maiaa jag loojhai lab lobh chit laae ||
verses.translation: They do not see the Messenger of Death; they long for Maya, and their consciousness is attached to greed.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so pir saachaa sadh hee saachaa naa oh marai na jaae ||3||
verses.translation: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik roveh pireh vichhu(n)neeaa a(n)dhee naa jaanai pir naale ||
verses.translation: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee saachaa pir milai a(n)tar sadhaa samaale ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they may meet with their True Husband, and cherish Him always deep within.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir a(n)tar samaale sadhaa hai naale manmukh jaataa dhoore ||
verses.translation: She cherishes her Husband deep within herself - He is always with her; the self-willed manmukhs think that He is far away.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੁਲੈ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan rulai rulaiaa kaam na aaiaa jin khasam na jaataa hadhoore ||
verses.translation: This body rolls in the dust, and is totally useless; it does not realize the Presence of the Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saa dhan milai milaiee pir a(n)tar sadhaa samaale ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride is united in Union; she cherishes her Beloved Husband forever, deep within herself.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: eik roveh pireh vichhu(n)neeaa a(n)dhee na jaanai pir hai naale ||4||2||
verses.translation: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: roveh pireh vichhu(n)neeaa mai pir sachaRaa hai sadhaa naale ||
verses.translation: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee chalan sahee jaaniaa satigur seveh naam samaale ||
verses.translation: Those who know that they must depart, serve the True Guru, and dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa naam samaale satigur hai naale satigur sev sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: They dwell constantly upon the Naam, and the True Guru is with them; they serve the True Guru, and so obtain peace.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe kaal maar sach ur dhaar fir aavan jaan na hoiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, they kill death, and enshrine the True Lord within their hearts; they shall not have to come and go again.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib sachee naiee vekhai nadhar nihaale ||
verses.translation: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; bestowing His Gracious Glance, one is enraptured.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: roveh pirahu vichhu(n)neeaa mai pir sachaRaa hai sadhaa naale ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਵ ਮਿਲਾਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh meraa saahib sabh dhoo uoochaa hai kiv milaa(n) preetam piaare ||
verses.translation: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur melee taa(n) sahaj milee pir raakhiaa ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru united me, then I was naturally united with my Husband Lord, and now, I keep Him clasped to my heart.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ur dhaare neh naal piaare satigur te pir dhisai ||
verses.translation: I constantly, lovingly cherish my Beloved within my heart; through the True Guru, I see my Beloved.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕਾ ਕਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh kaa kachaa cholaa tit paidhai pag khisai ||
verses.translation: The cloak of Maya's love is false; wearing it, one slips and loses his footing.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir ra(n)g raataa so sachaa cholaa tit paidhai tikhaa nivaare ||
verses.translation: That cloak is true, which is dyed in the color of the Love of my Beloved; wearing it, my inner thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prabh meraa saahib sabh dhoo uoochaa hai kiau milaa preetam piaare ||2||
verses.translation: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved? ||2||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai prabh sach pachhaaniaa hor bhoolee avaganiaare ||
verses.translation: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai sadhaa raave pir aapanaa sachaRai sabadh veechaare ||
verses.translation: I dwell constantly upon my Beloved Husband Lord, and reflect upon the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh veechaare ra(n)g raatee naare mil satigur preetam paiaa ||
verses.translation: The bride reflects upon the True Shabad, and is imbued with His Love; she meets with the True Guru, and finds her Beloved.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee giaa dhusaman dhookh sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: Deep within, she is imbued with His Love, and intoxicated with delight; her enemies and sufferings are all taken away.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: apane gur ka(n)au tan man dheejai taa(n) man bheejai tirasanaa dhookh nivaare ||
verses.translation: Surrender body and soul to your Guru, and then you shall become happy; your thirst and pain shall be taken away.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mai pir sach pachhaaniaa hor bhoolee avaganiaare ||3||
verses.translation: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: sachaRai aap jagat upaiaa gur bin ghor a(n)dhaaro ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aap milaae aap milai aape dhei piaaro ||
verses.translation: He Himself unites, and causes us to unite with Him; He Himself blesses us with His Love.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhei piaaro sahaj vaapaaro gurmukh janam savaare ||
verses.translation: He Himself blesses us with His Love, and deals in celestial peace; the life of the Gurmukh is reformed.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: dhan jag meh aaiaa aap gavaiaa dhar saachai sachiaaro ||
verses.translation: Blessed is his coming into the world; he banishes his self-conceit, and is acclaimed as true in the Court of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: giaan ratan ghaT chaanan hoaa naanak naam piaaro ||
verses.translation: The light of the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines within his heart, O Nanak, and he loves the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: sachaRai aap jagat upaiaa gur bin ghor a(n)dhaaro ||4||3||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih sareer jajaree hai is no jar pahuchai aae ||
verses.translation: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare hor mar ja(n)mai aavai jaae ||
verses.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: hor mar ja(n)meh aaveh jaaveh a(n)t ge pachhutaaveh bin naavai sukh na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going, and in the end, they depart regretfully. Without the Name, there is no peace.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai kamaavai so fal paavai manmukh hai pat khoiee ||
verses.translation: As one acts here, so does he obtain his rewards; the self-willed manmukh loses his honor.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਤਿਥੈ ਭੈਣ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jam pur ghor a(n)dhaar mahaa gubaar naa tithai bhain na bhaiee ||
verses.translation: In the City of Death, there is pitch darkness, and huge clouds of dust; neither sister nor brother is there.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eih sareer jajaree hai is no jar pahuchai aaiee ||1||
verses.translation: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa ka(n)chan taa(n) theeaai jaa(n) satigur le milaae ||
verses.translation: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਚੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhram maiaa vichahu kaTeeaai sachaRai naam samaae ||
verses.translation: Doubt and Maya have been removed from within me, and I am merged in the Naam, the True Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachai naam samaae har gun gaae mil preetam sukh paae ||
verses.translation: Merged in the True Name of the Lord, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; meeting my Beloved, I have found peace.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee vichahu ha(n)aumai jaae ||
verses.translation: I am in constant bliss, day and night; egotism has been dispelled from within me.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jinee purakhee har naam chit laiaa tin kai ha(n)au laagau paae ||
verses.translation: I fall at the feet of those who enshrine the Naam within their consciousness.

verses.original: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)iaa ka(n)chan taa(n) theeaai jaa satigur le milaae ||2||
verses.translation: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so sachaa sach salaaheeaai je satigur dhei bujhaae ||
verses.translation: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਨਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bharam bhulaaneeaa kiaa muh dhesan aagai jaae ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt; going to the world hereafter, what face will they display?

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਨਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਾਏ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa dhen muh jaae avagun pachhutaae dhukho dhukh kamaae ||
verses.translation: What face will they show, when they go there? They will regret and repent for their sins; their actions will bring them only pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam rateeaa se ra(n)g chaloolaa pir kai a(n)k samaae ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they merge into the Being of their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tis jevadd avar na soojhiee kis aagai kaheeaai jaae ||
verses.translation: I can conceive of no other as great as the Lord; unto whom should I go and speak?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so sachaa sach salaaheeaai je satigur dhei bujhaae ||3||
verses.translation: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sachaRaa sach salaahiaa ha(n)au tin laagau paae ||
verses.translation: I fall at the feet of those who praise the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se jan sache niramale tin miliaa mal sabh jaae ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings are true, and immaculately pure; meeting them, all filth is washed off.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tin miliaa mal sabh jaae sachai sar naae sachai sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: Meeting them, all filth is washed off; bathing in the Pool of Truth, one becomes truthful, with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam nira(n)jan agam agochar satigur dheeaa bujhaae ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has given me the realization of the Naam, the Immaculate Name of the Lord, the unfathomable, the imperceptible.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kareh ra(n)g raate naanak sach samaae ||
verses.translation: Those who perform devotional worship to the Lord night and day, are imbued with His Love; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jinee sachaRaa sach dhiaaiaa ha(n)au tin kai laagau paae ||4||4||
verses.translation: I fall at the feet of those who meditate on the Truest of the True. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਵਡਹੰਸ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਲਲਾਂ ਬਹਲੀਮਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਣੀ
verses.translit: vaddaha(n)s kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa lalaa(n) bahaleemaa kee dhun gaavanee
verses.translation: Vaar Of Wadahans, Fourth Mehla: To Be Sung In The Tune Of Lalaa-Behleemaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵਡ ਹੰਸ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate vadd ha(n)s hai sach naam ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: The great swans are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they enshrine the True Name within their hearts.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)graheh sadh sach raheh sachai naam piaar ||
verses.translation: They gather Truth, remain always in Truth, and love the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa niramal mail na lagiee nadhar keetee karataar ||
verses.translation: They are always pure and immaculate - filth does not touch them; they are blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hau tin kai balihaaranai jo anadhin japeh muraar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who, night and day, meditate on the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: mai jaaniaa vadd ha(n)s hai taa mai keeaa sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: I thought that he was a great swan, so I associated with him.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਦੇਦੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: je jaanaa bag bapuRaa ta janam na dhedhee a(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: If I had known that he was only a wretched heron from birth, I would not have touched him. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੰਸਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ ਬਗਾਂ ਭਿ ਆਯਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)saa vekh tara(n)dhiaa bagaa(n) bh aayaa chaau ||
verses.translation: Seeing the swans swimming, the herons became envious.

verses.original: ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ddub mue bag bapuRe sir tal upar paau ||3||
verses.translation: But the poor herons drowned and died, and floated with their heads down, and their feet above. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aape hee aap aap hai aap kaaran keeaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are Yourself, all by Yourself; You Yourself created the creation.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aape aap nira(n)kaar hai ko avar na beeaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are Yourself the Formless Lord; there is no other than You.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too karan kaaran samarath hai too kareh su theeaa ||
verses.translation: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes; what You do, comes to be.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਸਭਨਾਹਾ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too anama(n)giaa dhaan dhevanaa sabhanaahaa jeeaa ||
verses.translation: You give gifts to all beings, without their asking.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh aakhahu satigur vaahu vaahu jin dhaan har naam mukh dheeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Everyone proclaims, ""Waaho! Waaho! Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has given the supreme gift of the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:
