verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich sabh aakaar hai nirabhau har jeeau soi ||
verses.translation: The entire universe is in fear; only the Dear Lord is fearless.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai har man vasai tithai bhau kadhe na hoi ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, fear cannot stay there.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman dhukh tis no neR na aavai poh na sakai koi ||
verses.translation: Enemies and pain cannot come close, and no one can touch him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh man veechaariaa jo tis bhaavai su hoi ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh reflects upon the Lord in his mind; whatever pleases the Lord - that alone comes to pass.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aape hee pat rakhasee kaaraj savaare soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself preserves one's honor; He alone resolves our affairs. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸਜਣ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ਰਹਦੇ ਭੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik sajan chale ik chal ge rahadhe bhee fun jaeh ||
verses.translation: Some friends are leaving, some have already left, and those remaining will eventually leave.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee satigur na sevio se aai ge pachhutaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru, come and go regretting.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sach rate se na vichhuReh satigur sev samaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to Truth are not separated; serving the True Guru, they merge into the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਜਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis mileeaai satigur sajanai jis a(n)tar har gunakaaree ||
verses.translation: Meet with that True Guru, the True Friend, within whose mind the Lord, the virtuous One, abides.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis mileeaai satigur preetamai jin ha(n)aumai vichahu maaree ||
verses.translation: Meet with that Beloved True Guru, who has subdued ego from within himself.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur pooraa dhan dha(n)n hai jin har upadhes dhe sabh sirasiT savaaree ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Perfect True Guru, who has given the Lord's Teachings to reform the whole world.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: nit japiahu sa(n)tahu raam naam bhaujal bikh taaree ||
verses.translation: O Saints, meditate constantly on the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har upadhesiaa gur viTaRiahu ha(n)au sadh vaaree ||2||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has taught me about the Lord; I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa chaakaree sukhee hoo(n) sukh saar ||
verses.translation: Service to, and obedience to the True Guru, is the essence of comfort and peace.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai milan vaddiaaieeaa dharageh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Doing so, one obtains honor here, and the door of salvation in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachee kaar kamaavanee sach painan sach naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: In this way, perform the tasks of Truth, wear Truth, and take the Support of the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachee sa(n)gat sach milai sachai nai piaar ||
verses.translation: Associating with Truth, obtain Truth, and love the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh harakh sadhaa dhar sachai sachiaar ||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, be always happy, and you shall be acclaimed as True in the True Court.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur kee sevaa so karai jis no nadhar karai karataar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone serves the True Guru, whom the Creator has blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: hor viddaanee chaakaree dhirag jeevan dhirag vaas ||
verses.translation: Cursed is the life, and cursed is the dwelling, of those who serve another.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit chhodd bikh lage bikh khaTanaa bikh raas ||
verses.translation: Abandoning the Ambrosial Nectar, they turn to poison; they earn poison, and poison is their only wealth.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: bikh khaanaa bikh painanaa bikh ke mukh giraas ||
verses.translation: Poison is their food, and poison is their dress; they fill their mouths with morsels of poison.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai dhukho dhukh kamaavanaa muiaa narak nivaas ||
verses.translation: In this world, they earn only pain and suffering, and dying, they go to abide in hell.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh muh mailai sabadh na jaananee kaam karodh vinaas ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs have filthy faces; they do not know the Word of the Shabad; in sexual desire and anger they waste away.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa bhau chhoddiaa manahaTh ka(n)m na aavai raas ||
verses.translation: They forsake the Fear of the True Guru, and because of their stubborn ego, their efforts do not come to fruition.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jam pur badhe maare'eh ko na sune aradhaas ||
verses.translation: In the City of Death, they are bound and beaten, and no one hears their prayers.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa gurmukh naam nivaas ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; the Gurmukh abides in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur sevih saadh jan jin har har naam dhiraRaiaa ||
verses.translation: Serve the True Guru, O Holy people; He implants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in our minds.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur poojahu dhinas raat jin jaga(n)naath jagadhees japaiaa ||
verses.translation: Worship the True Guru day and night; He leads us the meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur dhekhahu ik nimakh nimakh jin har kaa har pa(n)th bataiaa ||
verses.translation: Behold the True Guru, each and every moment; He shows us the Divine Path of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪਗੀ ਪਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis satigur kee sabh pagee pavahu jin moh a(n)dher chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Let everyone fall at the feet of the True Guru; He has dispelled the darkness of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so satagur kahahu sabh dha(n)n dha(n)n jin har bhagat bha(n)ddaar lahaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Let everyone hail and praise the True Guru, who has led us to find the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai bhukh giee bhekhee bhukh na jai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, hunger departs; by wearing the robes of a beggar, hunger does not depart.

verses.original: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਗੈ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh lagai ghar ghar firai agai dhoonee milai sajai ||
verses.translation: Afflicted with pain, he wanders from house to house, and in the world hereafter, he receives double punishment.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar sahaj na aaio sahaje hee lai khai ||
verses.translation: Peace does not come to his heart - he is not content to eat what comes his way.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਲੈਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh jis te ma(n)ganaa lainaa dhukh manai ||
verses.translation: With his stubborn mind, he begs, and grabs, and annoys those who give.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਭੇਖੈ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗਿਰਹੋ ਭਲਾ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis bhekhai thaavahu giraho bhalaa jithahu ko varasai ||
verses.translation: Instead of wearing these beggar's robes, it is better to be a householder, and give to others.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate tinaa sojhee piee dhoojai bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Word of the Shabad, acquire understanding; the others wander, deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: piaai kirat kamaavanaa kahanaa kachhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: They act according to their past actions; it is useless to talk to them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jo tis bhaaveh se bhale jin kee pat paaveh thai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are pleasing unto the Lord are good; He upholds their honor. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai sadhaa sukh janam maran dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, one finds a lasting peace; the pains of birth and death are removed.

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)taa mool na hoviee achi(n)t vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: He is not troubled by anxiety, and the carefree Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar teerath giaan hai satigur dheeaa bujhai ||
verses.translation: Deep within himself, is the sacred shrine of spiritual wisdom, revealed by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mail giee man niramal hoaa a(n)mirat sar teerath nai ||
verses.translation: His filth is removed, and his soul becomes immaculately pure, bathing in the sacred shrine, the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sajan mile sajanaa sachai sabadh subhai ||
verses.translation: The friend meets with the True Friend, the Lord, through the love of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hee parachaa paiaa jotee jot milai ||
verses.translation: Within the home of his own being, he finds the Divine Self, and his light blends with the Light.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd jamakaal na chhoddiee lai jaasee pat gavai ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not leave the hypocrite; he is led away in dishonor.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate se ubare sache siau liv lai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are saved; they are in love with the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: tit jai bahahu satasa(n)gatee jithai har kaa har naam biloieeaai ||
verses.translation: Go, and sit in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Name of the Lord is churned.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਖੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje hee har naam leh har tat na khoieeaai ||
verses.translation: In peace and poise, contemplate the Lord's Name - don't lose the essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: nit japiahu har har dhinas raat har dharageh ddoieeaai ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, constantly, day and night, and you shall be accepted in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: so paae pooraa sataguroo jis dhur masatak lilaaT likhoieeaai ||
verses.translation: He alone finds the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such a pre-ordained destiny is written.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਈਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tis gur ka(n)au sabh namasakaar karahu jin har kee har gaal galoieeaai ||4||
verses.translation: Let everyone bow in worship to the Guru, who utters the sermon of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sajan mile sajanaa jin satagur naal piaar ||
verses.translation: The friends who love the True Guru, meet with the Lord, the True Friend.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mil preetam tinee dhiaaiaa sachai prem piaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting their Beloved, they meditate on the True Lord with love and affection.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man hee te man maaniaa gur kai sabadh apaar ||
verses.translation: Their minds are appeased by their own minds, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eh sajan mile na vichhuReh j aap mele karataar ||
verses.translation: These friends are united, and will not be separated again; they have been united by the Creator Lord Himself.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa dharasan kee parateet na aaieeaa sabadh na kareh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Some do not believe in the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; they do not contemplate the Shabad.

verses.original: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vichhuRiaa kaa kiaa vichhuRai jinaa dhoojai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: The separated ones are in love with duality - what more separation can they suffer?

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh setee dhosatee thoRaRiaa dhin chaar ||
verses.translation: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs lasts for only a few short days.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਤੁਟਦੀ ਵਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਇਤੁ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਚਲਨਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eis pareetee tuTadhee vilam na hoviee it dhosatee chalan vikaar ||
verses.translation: This friendship is broken in an instant; this friendship leads to corruption.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa a(n)dhar sache kaa bhau naahee naam na kareh piaar ||
verses.translation: They do not fear the True Lord within their hearts, and they do not love the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tin siau kiaa keechai dhosatee j aap bhulaae karataar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, why become friends with those whom the Creator Lord Himself has misled? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eik sadhaa ikatai ra(n)g raheh tin kai hau sadh balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: Some remain constantly imbued with the Lord's Love; I am forever a sacrifice to them.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhan arapee tin kau niv niv laagau pai ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind, soul and wealth to them; bowing low, I fall at their feet.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin miliaa man sa(n)tokheeaai tirasanaa bhukh sabh jai ||
verses.translation: Meeting them, the soul is satisfied, and one's hunger and thirst all depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate sukhe'ee sadhaa sache siau liv lai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are happy forever; they lovingly focus their minds on the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau hau vaariaa jin har kee har kathaa sunaiee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who recites the sermon of the Lord's Teachings.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau sadh balihaaranai jin har sevaa banat banaiee ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru, who has led me to serve the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਮੈਨੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur piaaraa merai naal hai jithai kithai maino le chhaddaiee ||
verses.translation: That Beloved True Guru is always with me; wherever I may be, He will save me.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau saabaas hai jin har sojhee paiee ||
verses.translation: Most blessed is that Guru, who imparts understanding of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak gur viTahu vaariaa jin har naam dheeaa mere man kee aas puraiee ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has given me the Lord's Name, and fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਧੀ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਈ ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa dhaadhee jal muiee jal jal kare pukaar ||
verses.translation: Consumed by desires, the world is burning and dying; burning and burning, it cries out.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seetal je milai fir jalai na dhoojee vaar ||
verses.translation: But if it meets with the cooling and soothing True Guru, it does not burn any longer.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vin naavai nirabhau ko nahee jichar sabadh na kare veechaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, and without contemplating the Word of the Shabad, no one becomes fearless. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੇਖੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhekhee agan na bujhiee chi(n)taa hai man maeh ||
verses.translation: Wearing ceremonial robes, the fire is not quenched, and the mind is filled with anxiety.

verses.original: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: varamee maaree saap na marai tiau nigure karam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: Destroying the snake's hole, the snake is not killed; it is just like doing deeds without a Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa seveeaai sabadh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Serving the Giver, the True Guru, the Shabad comes to abide in the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal saa(n)t hoi tirasanaa agan bujhai ||
verses.translation: The mind and body are cooled and soothed; peace ensues, and the fire of desire is quenched.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukhaa sir sadhaa sukh hoi jaa vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: The supreme comforts and lasting peace are obtained, when one eradicates ego from within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh udhaasee so kare j sach rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: He alone becomes a detached Gurmukh, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜਾ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)taa mool na hoviee har naam rajaa aaghai ||
verses.translation: Anxiety does not affect him at all; he is satisfied and satiated with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam binaa neh chhooTeeaai haumai pacheh pachai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, no one is saved; they are utterly ruined by egotism. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਅੜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jinee har har naam dhiaaiaa tinee paiaRe sarab sukhaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, obtain all peace and comforts.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੁਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh janam tinaa kaa safal hai jin har ke naam kee man laagee bhukhaa ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the entire life of those, who hunger for the Name of the Lord in their minds.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jinee gur kai bachan aaraadhiaa tin visar ge sabh dhukhaa ||
verses.translation: Those who worship the Lord in adoration, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, forget all their pains and suffering.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੁਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: te sa(n)t bhale gursikh hai jin naahee chi(n)t paraiee chukhaa ||
verses.translation: Those Gursikhs are good Saints, who care for nothing other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n tinaa kaa guroo hai jis a(n)mirat fal har laage mukhaa ||6||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is their Guru, whose mouth tastes the Ambrosial Fruit of the Lord's Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kal meh jam ja(n)dhaar hai hukame kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Messenger of Death is the enemy of life, but he acts according to the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare manmukhaa dhei sajai ||
verses.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs receive their punishment.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਫਰੂ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaalai vas jag baa(n)dhiaa tis dhaa faroo na koi ||
verses.translation: The world is under the control, and in the bondage of the Messenger of Death; no one can hold him back.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin jam keetaa so seveeaai gurmukh dhukh na hoi ||
verses.translation: So serve the One who created Death; as Gurmukh, no pain shall touch you.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਮੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh jam sevaa kare jin man sachaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, Death serves the Gurmukhs; the True Lord abides in their minds. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ehaa kaiaa rog bharee bin sabadhai dhukh haumai rog na jai ||
verses.translation: This body is filled with disease; without the Word of the Shabad, the pain of the disease of ego does not depart.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai taa niramal hovai har naamo ma(n)n vasai ||
verses.translation: When one meets the True Guru, then he becomes immaculately pure, and he enshrines the Lord's Name within his mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaiaa sukhadhaataa dhukh visariaa sahaj subhai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Peace-Giving Lord, his pains are automatically forgotten. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin jagajeevan upadhesiaa tis gur kau hau sadhaa ghumaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has taught me about the Lord, the Life of the World.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau hau kha(n)neeaai jin madhusoodhan har naam sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am every bit a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lover of Nectar, who has revealed the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau hau vaaranai jin haumai bikh sabh rog gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has totally cured me of the fatal disease of egotism.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਟਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis satigur kau vadd pu(n)n hai jin avagan kaT gunee samajhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Glorious and great are the virtues of the Guru, who has eradicated evil, and instructed me in virtue.
